Job Description:

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Shopper Marketing Manager to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food maker with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. Founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry across three major geographic regions.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here's The Scoop – Summary

We are seeking a strategic and commercially driven Shopper Marketing Manager to lead the development and execution of customer-specific shopper marketing strategies across key retail partners in the US.

This role will be responsible for translating brand and consumer strategies into impactful omnichannel activations across in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and digital touchpoints to drive conversion.

The ideal candidate brings deep CPG experience, strong commercial acumen, retail media expertise, and a proven ability to partner cross-functionally across Sales, Brand, Category, and Digital teams.

We are looking for a highly collaborative leader with strong retailer understanding, agency management experience, and a passion for building best-in-class shopper programs that deliver measurable business results.

What a typical day looks like:

Develop Customer-Specific Shopper Marketing Strategies. Build annual shopper marketing plans aligned to brand priorities, customer strategies, and channel growth objectives. Lead Retail Activation Planning & Execution. Design and execute omnichannel shopper activations across in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and key shopper touchpoints to drive conversion. Partner Closely with Sales / Key Account Teams. Act as a strategic business partner to Sales, developing customer-selling stories, retailer-specific programs, and Joint Business Plans (JBPs). Translate Consumer Insights into Shopper Activations. Leverage shopper, consumer, and category insights to identify purchase barriers/opportunities, translating them into impactful programs that influence path-to-purchase behavior. Lead agency partners & Activation Development. Develop strategic briefs and lead external shopper marketing, creative, and retail media partners to build integrated activations that drive shopper conversion. Manage Retail Media & Digital Commerce Integration. Partner with retail media, eCommerce, and merchandising teams to build integrated shopper campaigns across retailer ecosystems, ensuring alignment across the full shopper journey. Oversee Merchandising & Promotional Programs. Develop and optimize promotions, display strategies, and merchandising initiatives to maximize incremental sales. Measure ROI and Performance Effectiveness. Track activation performance using KPIs such as sales lift, ROI, incrementality, conversion, TDP growth, and promotional efficiency. Manage Shopper Marketing Budget & Investment Allocation. Own budget planning, spend tracking, and optimization to ensure efficient investment across customers and channels. Collaborate Cross-Functionally. Partner with Brand, Category Management, Sales, and Supply to ensure aligned, scalable, and executable programs. Build Best-in-Class Retailer Relationships. Develop strong relationships with retailer marketing and commercial teams to unlock shopper activation opportunities, better placements, and joint growth opportunities. 

What are we looking for?

10+ years of experience in CPG, preferably across Shopper Marketing, Customer Marketing, Brand Marketing, and/or Trade Marketing. Proven experience developing and leading omnichannel shopper marketing programs, integrating in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and digital activation to drive conversion and brand growth. Strong experience integrating shopper marketing into customer business plans, Joint Business Plans (JBPs), innovation launches, and channel growth strategies, with the ability to influence customer and internal commercial agendas. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to connect shopper activations to business outcomes including revenue growth, incrementality, ROI, TDP gains, velocity, and promotional efficiency. Hands-on experience developing and leading retail media campaigns, with strong understanding of audience strategy, media optimization, attribution, and lower-funnel conversion. Strong analytical and shopper insights capabilities, including proficiency in syndicated and retailer data sources such as Nielsen, Circana, panel data, loyalty data, and point-of-sale analytics. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, partnering effectively across Brand, Sales and Digital teams to drive alignment and execution. Experience working directly with major US retailers and their marketing/commercial teams, with strong understanding of customer-specific activation principles. Experience managing shopper marketing budget including investment planning, allocation, and management. 

What can you expect from Champion?

Safety: a strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.Earnings: Salary range from USD$105,000 to USD$144,000, 401k with Company, and donation matching.Industry Competitive Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Employee Assistance Programs to meet your individual or family needs.Continuing Education: In House & Online Learning & Development, as well as an Education Assistance Program.Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.Other Perks: Free Bag of Premium Pet Food each month, Free Parking and more!

What are you waiting for? Join the pack!

Come as you are.

We value diversity in all forms and know the power it can bring. Workplace equality allows for creative ideas to bloom, diverse points of views to be heard, and increases overall happiness. That sounds pretty good to us.

Champion is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of your race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other creed, you are wanted here.

The total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, if eligible, including variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Eligibility for these additional elements depend on the position offered and the employee’s work schedule (i.e., part-time schedule, store associate). Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

Position Summary

The Sales Analytics Manager leads a team of Sales Analysts who deliver actionable insights, reporting, and demand generating recommendations for the Coffee & Beverage (C&B) sales organization. This role develops analytical talent, strengthens reporting discipline, and helps translate complex data into clear business solutions.

The Sales Analytics Manager leads the analytical approach/strategy for the team and serves as a trusted analytical advisor to Sales Analytics and division sales leaders.

Primary Responsibilities

Analytical Expert: Lead the analytical approach and strategy for the C&B regional sales team.

Own key analytical projects & reporting initiatives for the wider Sales Analytics and C&B Sales teamStrategize, advise, and provide analytical support for Sales Analytics and division sales leadership Drive gold standard analytical behavior, data integrity, reliability, and timeliness across a teamDeliver best-in-class reporting solutions, dashboards, and scorecards through the utilization of complex data and cross functional collaborationChampion the creation and application of standardized reporting & Artificial Intelligence to drive efficiencies for the organization

Analytics Leadership: Coach, develop, and inspire a team of Sales Analysts that support the Coffee & Beverage Division’s regional account team.

Stakeholder Management: Serve as the trusted analytical advisor for Coffee & Beverage sales organization and leadership team.

Build strong relationships by understanding stakeholder needs and driving value added deliverablesPartner with stakeholders to support their KPIs and strategic business initiativesDemonstrate clear prioritization, communication, and decision-makingLead with a customer service mindset

Skills & Competencies

Demonstrates the ability to motivate, inspire, and lead a team of high performing individualsDisplays a strong understanding of business goals/needsProactively provide solutions and resources to achieve resultsExperience in problem-solving and project management skillsEmpowers individuals to solve problems, make decisions and improve processesFacilitates discussions that deal constructively with issues, leverages difficult situations to strengthen relationshipsProactively and constructively challenges current practices and processes, generates alternative perspectives and/or suggestions that create value for the organizationProvides practical business insights from complex data sets

Takes the initiative to quickly execute with minimal supervisionAbility to manage competing priorities across multiple team members, stakeholders, and business needs

Prior experience managing direct reportsExperience building team capabilities via onboarding, training, development and performance coachingKnowledge of core business processes and fundamentals (sales/distribution, merchandizing, customer planning and managing, financial reporting, Integrated Commercial Planning)Project Management skills or experience Proficiency in PowerBi

With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

The Planogram Specialist partners with Category Leadership Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to influence, build, validate, and execute merchandising solutions that support category growth. The role co-owns planogram development, planogram specific reporting, database maintenance, and ad hoc category analytics while evolving toward stronger process leadership, standardized ways of working, and scalable tools that improve speed, quality, and consistency across divisions. The role also contributes to assortment and layout thinking by applying shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights to strengthen shelf construct recommendations, planogram testing, heat mapping, and best-practice deployment.

Responsibilities

Planogram Development & Execution

 Builds multiple versions of planograms based on pre-established assortment, clustering nuances, fixture variations, merchandising guidelines, and retailer-specific requirements, while simultaneously developing customer-specific Gold Standard POG recommendations that optimize product flow, brand blocking, adjacencies, capacity, and execution feasibility to drive immediate merchandising objectives and support long-term category growth, shopper navigation, and strategic retailer goals. Reviews, validates, and revises planograms for adherence to retailer strategy, merchandising standards, fixture /labor realities, and execution readiness. Manages relay execution for assigned categories, including workload forecasting, project coordination, deadlines, and issue resolution required for successful implementation. Provides planogram support for display merchandising where applicable, including virtual store environments, 3D product builds, video tours, promotional concepts, and customer-facing visual assets that communicate the merchandising story.

Assortment, Layout & Shelf Strategy Support

 Supports assortment and layout strategy development by translating shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights into informed shelf recommendations. Contributes to planogram testing, heat mapping, clustering evaluations, fixture alternatives, and shelf construct analysis to improve category and brand outcomes. Provides analytical support for innovation, renovation, and new item/segment display considerations as needed.

Reporting, Analytics & Decision Support

 Conducts ad hoc analytics to answer business questions from Customer Merchants, Category Advisors, Category Leadership Managers, and non-advising teams. Supports business reviews and insights development using available resources such as JDA/Blue Yonder, retailer data, and internal reporting. Measures effectiveness of planogram, assortment, and shelving actions by connecting execution outputs to performance indicators where available.

Tools, Data & Capability Enablement

 Helps develop and improve the planogram toolbox, including standardized tables, templates, reporting views, process documents, and shared knowledge resources. Identifies opportunities to test, validate, and scale tools or automation that improve planogram development, reporting, and execution efficiency. Supports onboarding, training content, and best-practice sharing for analysts, field category teams, and partners using planogram or space planning tools. Maintains strong relationship with Acosta, Shopper MX, and key internal stakeholders to optimize merchandising tools, data integrity, digital assets, and operational processes, driving efficiencies, improving execution quality, and identifying scalable, cost-effective solutions that advance category management capabilities and customer outcomes.

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

 Acts as an efficient collaborator by sharing reporting, best practices, learnings, and reusable tools across divisions and customer teams. Brings forward-thinking recommendations through proposals, planogram testing insights, heat mapping, and scalable process improvements that support total Nestlé growth. Builds trusted relationships with Category Leadership, Space Planning Management, field sales, and cross-functional partners to improve quality, speed, and alignment.

Requirements

Education & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2+ years of experience in Sales, Analytics, Space Management, Category Management, or a related manufacturer/retailer role; CPG and/or food industry experience a plus, with demonstrated ability to influence merchandising recommendations through buyer-facing storytelling, cross-functional partnership, and category strategy application.

Technical & Analytical Skills

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel; advanced analytical aptitude and ability to develop business and category knowledge, including the expertise to simplify complex data into clear visuals, shelf stories, and executive-ready recommendations. Experience with Blue Yonder/JDA Space Management preferred; ability to use SQL, Python, or similar tools to improve data extraction, analysis, or planogram workflows a plus. Ability to use retailer, marketplace, shopper, category, and performance data to address business questions and improve merchandising recommendations.

Core Capabilities

 Strong project management, prioritization, and change-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently and in a team environment. Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into clear recommendations. Demonstrated initiative, tenacity, curiosity, and problem-solving; willingness to challenge current ways of working and help build future-state capabilities. Ability to collaborate across Category Leadership, Field Sales, and cross-functional partners while sharing knowledge and best practices.

Travel

Approximately 15–25% to include national meetings, local customer meetings, store visits, and other business needs.

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Job Location

WHBC - WINTON HILL BUS CENTER

Job Description

Research and Development (R&D) at Procter & Gamble, the largest consumer packaged goods company in the world, includes a diverse group of roles that contribute to the innovation and development of our products. It encompasses roles in product research, formulation, testing, and scientific analysis. You will find variety and excitement starting Day 1.

The Opportunity:

If you are passionate about applied materials science, energized by solving real consumer problems, and driven to modernize how work gets done through digital innovation, this role is for you. We are seeking a highly motivated PhD in Materials Science & Engineering, Chemistry, Polymer Science, or a related discipline to join the Feminine Care R&D organization at P&G in Cincinnati, OH. As a Material Development Scientist-PhD, you will utilize deep technical mastery to make meaningful, hands‑on contributions to the business. You will work in a collaborative, supportive R&D environment where your work directly influences product performance, sustainability, supply resilience, and speed of innovation.

This R&D assignment offers a unique opportunity to work across disciplines internally and with external partners, building both technical depth and system level understanding early in your career. The role also provides the opportunity to innovate across a range of material technologies including but not limited to Adhesives, Nonwovens, and Films to name a few. The role is well suited for scientists who enjoy connecting fundamental understanding to practical applications, and who are motivated to improve not only what we develop, but how we develop it.

The Ideal Candidate Has: 

A strong foundational understanding of materials science with the ability to apply fundamentals to solve real‑world problems. Ability to understand product performance requirements, material feedstocks, and manufacturing processes, and translate this holistic understanding into innovative material solutions.Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills, with the ability to leverage data to connect insights across disciplines, develop technically sound solutions, and influence technical direction on projects.Passion for hands‑on experimental work, with a demonstrated ability to design, execute, and interpret experiments; test technical hypotheses; and translate data into clear, actionable insights and models.A self‑leadership and ownership mindset, including the ability to independently understand complex technical problems, proactively drive problem solving, and collaborate with project teams on technology development.Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across multifunctional teams within P&G and with external partners such as suppliers, universities, and technical service providers.Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate technical concepts and results through written reports and verbal discussions.Demonstrated curiosity and innovation mindset, including interest or experience in using digital, data, or automation tools to simplify workflows, improve decision‑making, and accelerate materials innovation.Learning agility and adaptability, with the ability to rapidly learn new technical areas, tools, and processes in a dynamic, evolving business environment.

This is a fast‑paced, highly impactful role focused on developing new materials and material innovations to deliver superior, sustainable products through best‑in‑class execution and supply solutions.

In this role, you will:

Partner with Product Development teams to translate consumer needs and unmet problems into material innovations to deliver superior and differentiated product solutions.Work closely with manufacturing plants to diagnose and resolve raw‑material technical issues, enabling robust, reliable product performance.Collaborate with external suppliers to develop, qualify, and sustain best‑in‑class raw‑material supply chains for a global business.Lead and support new raw‑material qualifications, cost‑optimization initiatives, and Business Continuity Plans to strengthen resilience and competitiveness while meeting quality, safety, and compliance requirements.Apply digital and data‑driven approaches to simplify workflows, improve decision‑making, and accelerate the pace of materials innovation.

Job Qualifications

Required Qualifications: 

Education Requirement: PhD in Materials Science & Engineering, Chemistry, Polymer Science, or related field. Strong analytical skills with experience in data science, data analytics, statistics.Ability to travel approximately 10% of the time based on business need.Ability to work on-site at Winton Hill Business Center 3-5 days per week.

Preferred Qualifications: 

Publications in peer-reviewed scientific journals.Proficiency in coding and applying modeling and simulation methods/tools (such as GeoDict, Abaqus) to solve technical problems.Experience in developing and implementing AI solutions.

Just so you know: 

Compensation for roles at P&G varies depending on a wide array of non-discriminatory factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, degree/credentials, relevant skill set, and level of relevant experience. At P&G compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Total rewards at P&G include salary + bonus (if applicable) + benefits. Your recruiter may be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the hiring process.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities in employment. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Immigration Sponsorship is not available for this role. For more information regarding who is eligible for hire at P&G along with other work authorization FAQ’s, please click HERE.

Procter & Gamble participates in E-Verify.

Qualified individuals will not be disadvantaged based on being unemployed.

P&G is dedicated to meeting the needs of applicants requesting an accommodation/adjustment due to a disability in order to complete the online application process. If you have a disability that affects your ability to complete our online application process, please visit our Disability Accommodation Page.

P&G was founded more than 185 years ago as a soap and candle company. Today, we’re one of the world’s largest consumer goods companies and home to iconic, trusted brands, including Always®, Charmin®, Braun®, Fairy®, Febreze®, Gillette®, Head & Shoulders®, Oral B®, Pantene®, Pampers®, Tide®, and Vicks®.

Just as we strive to deliver a superior consumer experience, we aim to deliver a superior employee value equation as well. Here, we want you to get your career off to a fast start. Join us and help make life better through meaningful work that makes an impact from Day 1.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Description:

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Shopper Marketing Manager to join our rapidly growing company.

Champion Petfoods is an award-winning pet food maker with a reputation of trust spanning 35+ years. Founded in a small town in Alberta, Canada, Champion – with its ORIJEN® and ACANA® brands – is a key player in the global premium pet food industry across three major geographic regions.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here's The Scoop – Summary

We are seeking a strategic and commercially driven Shopper Marketing Manager to lead the development and execution of customer-specific shopper marketing strategies across key retail partners in the US.

This role will be responsible for translating brand and consumer strategies into impactful omnichannel activations across in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and digital touchpoints to drive conversion.

The ideal candidate brings deep CPG experience, strong commercial acumen, retail media expertise, and a proven ability to partner cross-functionally across Sales, Brand, Category, and Digital teams.

We are looking for a highly collaborative leader with strong retailer understanding, agency management experience, and a passion for building best-in-class shopper programs that deliver measurable business results.

What a typical day looks like:

Develop Customer-Specific Shopper Marketing Strategies. Build annual shopper marketing plans aligned to brand priorities, customer strategies, and channel growth objectives. Lead Retail Activation Planning & Execution. Design and execute omnichannel shopper activations across in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and key shopper touchpoints to drive conversion. Partner Closely with Sales / Key Account Teams. Act as a strategic business partner to Sales, developing customer-selling stories, retailer-specific programs, and Joint Business Plans (JBPs). Translate Consumer Insights into Shopper Activations. Leverage shopper, consumer, and category insights to identify purchase barriers/opportunities, translating them into impactful programs that influence path-to-purchase behavior. Lead agency partners & Activation Development. Develop strategic briefs and lead external shopper marketing, creative, and retail media partners to build integrated activations that drive shopper conversion. Manage Retail Media & Digital Commerce Integration. Partner with retail media, eCommerce, and merchandising teams to build integrated shopper campaigns across retailer ecosystems, ensuring alignment across the full shopper journey. Oversee Merchandising & Promotional Programs. Develop and optimize promotions, display strategies, and merchandising initiatives to maximize incremental sales. Measure ROI and Performance Effectiveness. Track activation performance using KPIs such as sales lift, ROI, incrementality, conversion, TDP growth, and promotional efficiency. Manage Shopper Marketing Budget & Investment Allocation. Own budget planning, spend tracking, and optimization to ensure efficient investment across customers and channels. Collaborate Cross-Functionally. Partner with Brand, Category Management, Sales, and Supply to ensure aligned, scalable, and executable programs. Build Best-in-Class Retailer Relationships. Develop strong relationships with retailer marketing and commercial teams to unlock shopper activation opportunities, better placements, and joint growth opportunities. 

What are we looking for?

10+ years of experience in CPG, preferably across Shopper Marketing, Customer Marketing, Brand Marketing, and/or Trade Marketing. Proven experience developing and leading omnichannel shopper marketing programs, integrating in-store, eCommerce, retail media, and digital activation to drive conversion and brand growth. Strong experience integrating shopper marketing into customer business plans, Joint Business Plans (JBPs), innovation launches, and channel growth strategies, with the ability to influence customer and internal commercial agendas. Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to connect shopper activations to business outcomes including revenue growth, incrementality, ROI, TDP gains, velocity, and promotional efficiency. Hands-on experience developing and leading retail media campaigns, with strong understanding of audience strategy, media optimization, attribution, and lower-funnel conversion. Strong analytical and shopper insights capabilities, including proficiency in syndicated and retailer data sources such as Nielsen, Circana, panel data, loyalty data, and point-of-sale analytics. Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams, partnering effectively across Brand, Sales and Digital teams to drive alignment and execution. Experience working directly with major US retailers and their marketing/commercial teams, with strong understanding of customer-specific activation principles. Experience managing shopper marketing budget including investment planning, allocation, and management. 

What can you expect from Champion?

Safety: a strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.Earnings: Salary range from USD$105,000 to USD$144,000, 401k with Company, and donation matching.Industry Competitive Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Employee Assistance Programs to meet your individual or family needs.Continuing Education: In House & Online Learning & Development, as well as an Education Assistance Program.Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.Other Perks: Free Bag of Premium Pet Food each month, Free Parking and more!

What are you waiting for? Join the pack!

Come as you are.

We value diversity in all forms and know the power it can bring. Workplace equality allows for creative ideas to bloom, diverse points of views to be heard, and increases overall happiness. That sounds pretty good to us.

Champion is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of your race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, age, veteran status, or any other creed, you are wanted here.

company.description:
As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

Contribute to the evolution from Category Management to Category Development (thought leadership and enhanced story telling), focusing on long-term growth and innovation.

company.description:
As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

Job Description:

The Senior Manager Global Workforce & Organizational Effectiveness Intelligence is a key member of the Organization Effectiveness and Workforce Planning Center of Excellence (COE). This is a high-impact position for an experienced workforce analytics consultant with functional expertise who excels at translating strategic business challenges into structured workforce intelligence and executive action. This role serves as the lead analytical and consulting partner to the COE, bridging the gap between strategic business questions and the workforce intelligence required for executive decision-making.

The successful candidate possesses deep domain knowledge in workforce planning, organization effectiveness, and workforce intelligence, combined with key consulting skills such as structured problem-solving and executive communication. You will be responsible for defining what to measure and how to measure it, interpreting complex data to tell a compelling business story, and advising senior leaders on workforce and org effectiveness implications. This position plays a critical role in establishing enterprise-wide standards for workforce and org effectiveness metrics and monitoring organizational health.

Operating in a decentralized, multi-business unit organization, you will partner with P&O (people & operations or HR), finance, and business leaders at the enterprise and business-unit level. You will serve as a bridge between the COE, business-units, P&O (HR) technology teams, corporate finance, and commercial teams.

What we are looking for? 

Bachelor's degree; Master's degree in a relevant field (e.g., I/O Psychology, MBA, HR, Business Analytics) is preferred.8 years of experience across strategic workforce planning, org design / operating model, and organization effectiveness analyticsMinimum of 6 years of experience in Management Consulting (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte, or specialized boutique human capital firm) advising large, complex organizations on organization effectiveness, operating models, and workforce planning OR 6 years of in-house experience at a global, multi-business unit company, serving either in a corporate Center of Excellence for Workforce Planning / Org Effectiveness, or in a similar headquarters role for a major business unitMinimum of 6 years of experience with Workday as well as workforce planning and org effectiveness tools (e.g., Orgvue, Visier, Workday Adaptive, Anaplan). This includes functional proficiency and strategic command of these tools, with an emphasis on how organizational data is represented and modeledDeep functional expertise in organization effectiveness and strategic workforce planning frameworks, metrics, and benchmarks - including leading practices, operational complexities, and risksProven experience establishing enterprise-level workforce and OE metrics for large organizations, including advising on P&O (HR) and finance metrics integrationAdvanced Microsoft Excel and data visualization tool (Power BI, Tableau) capabilities for ad-hoc modeling, data blending, and scenario explorationProven expertise in translating abstract business questions into structured workforce planning and org effectiveness analytical plans, with a proven track record of delivering high-impact insights that influence executive decisionsDemonstrated ability to serve as a translator between senior P&O (HR), finance, and commercial leaders, aligning disparate stakeholder groups around a shared understanding of the strategic implications of workforce dataExposure to how Artificial Intelligence (AI) is changing SWP and OE, including: familiarity with emerging AI-driven metrics and enhanced workforce intelligence, including skills-based organization design, and measuring AI-human productivityWorking knowledge of data querying concepts (e.g., SQL) and data architecture paradigms (e.g., data lakes) to facilitate effective partnership with P&O (HR) technical teams

What will be your key responsibilities?

 Strategic ConsultingAssist with designing and leading the COE’s Workforce Intelligence agenda to enable workforce planning and monitor organizational health, productivity, and effectivenessAdvise on workforce planning and org effectiveness benchmarks and assist with developing targetsProvide thought leadership on the continued impact of AI transformation on workforce planning and org effectiveness metricsServe as a thought partner, translating ambiguous executive workforce planning and org effectiveness questions into hypotheses and structured analysisDevelop and deliver compelling presentations to senior leadership that clearly articulate workforce and org effectiveness trends, risks, and opportunities, influencing data-driven decisions Enterprise Workforce Intelligence & Org Effectiveness IntelligenceDesign and conduct workforce planning and organizational effectiveness analysis, synthesizing disparate data points (P&O / HR, financial, commercial, external) to proactively identify insights and risksMonitor organizational health, complexity, and productivity. About the job

Our Finance team works with teams across the company to ensure Danone continues to grow. By joining our Finance team, you will anticipate and evaluate the financial impact of decisions and find the right way forward. We currently have an amazing opportunity for a Finance Analyst based in White Plains, NY or Broomfield, CO!


In this role, you will be responsible for

  • Marketing Partnership Collaborate with U.S. marketing teams to evaluate spend effectiveness, optimize ROI, and inform investment decisions at brand and tactic levels
  • Digital Commerce Partnership Work closely with the digital commerce team to analyze and articulate performance across channels and business units
  • Enterprise Strategy Partnership Partner with Enterprise planning team and assist with DBPS planning and other adhoc analytics and projects
  • Serve as a financial partner to business leaders by organizing financial information in a manner that facilitates strategic business planning
  • Assist in preparing materials for senior management on monthly, quarterly and annual basis
  • Proactively manage process, meetings and calendars to ensure timeliness and efficiency of budget and month end procedures

The salary range for this position is $75,000 - $95,000 USD. The exact salary offered will depend on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant experience, geographic location, internal equity, and market conditions. Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options. To give our employees flexibility, Danone is a hybrid work environment.


This role is considered a “hybrid” position that allows for flexible work, meaning it is a role where collaboration with key stakeholders in Danone Hubs occurs. While you may have the option to work from home on a schedule as agreed to with your supervisor, you are also expected to regularly report to your assigned office location at least 3 days per week.

  • You have a bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field, preferably Finance, Accounting, or Economics required; MBA or advanced business-related degree preferred

Job Title AVP - Head of Global Digital & Media Strategy – Color Wow DMI

Division: Professional Products Division

Location: Color Wow Offices - 195 Danbury Rd, Wilton, CT, Tentatively Mid - 2027 - L’Oreal NYO - 10 Hudson Yards, New York, NY

Reports To: General Manager (GM), Color WOW DMI

Who We Are

At the heart of our company lies a dedication to innovation and progress. In all markets where we operate, we're committed to fostering excellence, empowering talented individuals, and leading the way in various industries.

Join L'Oréal: As the world's #1 beauty company, with a presence in over 150 markets, we are embarking on a transformative journey that embraces sustainability, digital innovation, and societal progress. We are dedicated to shaping the future of beauty by harnessing the power of technology, data, and science to tackle global challenges while staying true to our social and environmental commitments.

We're proud to have earned recognition as industry leaders in:

Most Innovative Companies - Fast Company, 2023Top 5 - Most Attractive Companies Worldwide Among Business Students - Universum, 2023Top 25 World's Best Companies - TIME, 2023 Top Companies for Executive Women - Seamount, 2023Best Place to Work for Disability Inclusion - Disability Equal Index, 2023

With 86,000 dedicated employees spread across 150 countries, L'Oréal leads the global beauty industry and pioneers’ beauty technology. Our portfolio comprises 36 international brands grouped into four divisions. For over a century, we've been committed to making beauty accessible to all, and our goal is to reach another billion consumers worldwide through innovation.

Now, it's your moment to shine. If you are experienced, embrace challenges, value continuous learning, and want to create a positive impact, we invite you to join our diverse teams. Whether you're an industry veteran or a seasoned professional, we are always on the lookout for exceptional talents to contribute to our mission.

At L'Oréal Professional Products Division, we have more than 110 years of avant-garde to define the present and shape the future of professional beauty. We are an open space for innovation and technology while we take care of the planet, creating more hope and less waste, we create as unique experiences in every channel, just as unique as you are as you are. We are the cutting edge. If you are passionate about beauty, technology and sustainability; motivated by data, disruptive, creative and a great team player, I will be thrill to talk to you about this opportunity.

A Day in the Life

The AVP, Head of Global Digital & Media Strategy directs and holds ultimate global accountability for Color WOW’s end-to-end digital ecosystem, steering full-funnel media strategy, unified analytics, search optimization, lifecycle CRM, e-commerce content, and cutting-edge digital services innovation. Acting at the intersection of brand vision, digital transformation, and multi-market commercial execution, this executive leader partners cross-functionally across DMI, CDMO, and international zone leadership to build brand equity, accelerate consumer acquisition, maximize customer lifetime value, and drive sustainable global business growth.

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Digital Media, Business Administration, or related discipline.Years of Experience: 10–12+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital marketing, full-funnel media strategy, e-commerce, or CDMO roles, preferably within beauty, luxury, or prestige consumer goods.Job Specific Experience/Skills:Proven track record of directing, scaling, and governing a comprehensive global digital ecosystem (Paid/Owned/Earned Media, Performance Analytics, Lifecycle CRM, B2B/B2C E-Commerce).In-depth expertise in Retail Media networks, digital shelf optimization, affiliate marketing, brand seeding, and community management platforms.Demonstrated mastery of Global Engine Optimization (GEO) / SEO strategies, search content architecture, and multi-market master asset syndication (including US English-to-Spanish localization).High-level executive leadership managing top-tier global agency partners, MarTech/AdTech vendors, and matrixed international market teams.Technical Skills: Proficiency with enterprise digital analytics suites, media buying/ad platforms, CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce), e-commerce platforms, and MS Office Suite.Physical Requirements: Physical in-office presence required (up to 2 days per week required in the Color Wow Office in Wilton, CT; remaining time aligned with company hybrid policy); standard executive office activities (sitting, standing, computer work).
Preferred Qualifications

Master’s / MBA or advanced degree in relevant field.Experience integrating emerging Beauty Tech / Consumer AI solutions (e.g., AI hair diagnosis, virtual try-on tools, conversational AI companions).

Responsibilities

Digital Ecosystem Governance: Direct and hold ultimate global accountability for Color WOW’s digital footprint across all core pillars: Full-Funnel Media & Content Formats, Analytics & Insights (Paid/Owned/Earned), E-Commerce B2B & B2C (Content & Activations), GEO Search Strategy, DDX Lifecycle CRM (Triggers & Journeys), and Digital Services.Media Strategy & Alignment: Coordinate the overarching global media strategy with Marketing and Content leads to ensure fit-for-format asset development across all funnel stages; establish divisional Rules of Engagement (ROE) and provide strategic steering for Retail Media investments tied directly to designated Hero SKUs.Analytics & Insights (A&I) Leadership: Oversee the global A&I strategy, including unified multi-touchpoint digital analytics, brand seeding, creator affiliate programs (closely integrated with E-Commerce), and community management technologies.GEO & Global Search Strategy: Define strategic global search territories in close partnership with Marketing; lead English master search content creation, manage specialized agency partners, and syndicate master assets to regional markets for localization (e.g., US English-to-Spanish adaptation).Lifecycle CRM (DDX): Direct global CRM architecture and retention strategy, designing automated consumer lifecycle triggers and personalized multi-channel journeys across both direct consumer (B2C) and salon professional (B2B) touchpoints.Digital Services & Beauty Tech Innovation: Serve as the primary DMI liaison to the division’s "Digital Services Factory" to pilot, commercialize, and scale next-generation consumer-facing technologies (AI hair diagnosis, virtual try-ons, conversational AI companions).People & Operational Leadership: Lead, develop, and mentor direct team members while maintaining a close operational partnership with the Head of E-Commerce (Primary Deputy) and cross-functional DMI leaders.

Key Challenges, Issues and Complexity 

Harmonizing Full-Funnel Performance & Long-Term Brand Equity: Balancing aggressive direct-to-consumer e-commerce goals and retail media ROI with premium brand equity across international markets with varying digital maturity levels.Multi-Market Master Governance & Localization: Architecting global digital toolkits, search territories, and content frameworks that can be efficiently localized, translated, and executed across complex matrixed zone and country teams.Pioneering Beauty Tech Integration: Partnering with central innovation hubs to pilot and scale complex AI-driven digital services (diagnostics, virtual tools) that drive measurable consumer engagement and commercial impact.

Organization Structure and Key Working Relationships 

Reports To: General Manager (GM), Color WOW DMIDecision-Making Level (RACI): Accountable (A) for Global Digital & Media Strategy, Multi-Channel Governance, and A&IPrimary Backup / Deputy: Head of E-CommerceKey Working Relationships & Collaborators:Internal: Global Head of Color WOW DMI (GM), Division CDMO Leadership, Head of Marketing, Head of Content/Creative, Head of E-Commerce, Global Retail Teams, Zone/Country Digital Leads, Central Digital Services Factory.External: Global Media & Creative Agencies, Search/SEO Agencies, Retail Media & AdTech Partners (Amazon, Ulta, Sephora, Google, Meta, TikTok), Tech Vendors.Communication & Collaboration: Multi-market steering committees, executive briefings, strategic playbooks, KPI dashboards, and recurring cross-functional forums (verbal, written, visual).
Job Dimensions 

Operating Budget: Global Digital & Media OPEX / Working Media & Technology GovernanceNumber of Direct Reports: up to 3 direct reports (Digital Media, A&I, CRM, Search/Digital Services leads)Total Staff / Scope: 1 FTE (Direct) with extensive global matrix leadership across international zonesArea of Impact: Global Brand Strategy, DMI, Multi-Zone Commercial & Digital PerformanceNature of Impact: Strategic direction, governance, cross-zone coordination, and multi-market deliveryOther Key Metrics: Media ROI / ROAS, E-Commerce Growth, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Share of Voice (SOV), Organic & Paid Search Visibility, Retention / Repeat Purchase Rate, Digital Service Engagement

What We Offer

Salary Range: $147,100– $213,300 (The actual compensation will depend on a variety of job-related factors which may include geographic location, work experience, education, and skill level Competitive Benefit Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Pension Plan)

Hybrid Work Policy (Up to 2 Days per week work from home for eligible roles, subject to manager approval.)

Flexible Time Off (Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Vacation Buy Program, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!)

Access to Company Perks (VIP Access to L’Oréal’s Internal Shop for Discounted Products, Monthly Mobile Allowance)

Learning & Development Opportunities (Unlimited Access to E-learnings, Lunch & Learn Sessions, Mentorship Programs, & More!

Employee Resource Groups (Think Tanks and Innovation Squads)

Access to Mental Health & Wellness Programs

Your Future Team

At L’Oréal, our Digital team is an opportunity to be at the center of L'Oréal's digital transformation. We are determined to be pioneers in the new beauty tech world, and by incorporating digital into everything that we do, we are creating a better relationship with our consumers. When beauty and tech collide, the impossible can happen! Come join our dynamic team!

We Are Committed and Engaged

Don’t meet every single requirement? At L'Oréal, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse environment. We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or disability, or any other legally protected status.

If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran and need a reasonable accommodation during the application or hiring process, please contact USApplicationAccommodation@support.lorealusa.com. If you need assistance to accommodate a disability, you may request an accommodation at any time.

All of your information will be kept confidential, to the maximum extent permitted by law, according to EEO guidelines.

Our Safe Together Plan: Your safety is our highest priority. We will proceed with caution and adhere to enhanced protection standards to ensure our sites are safe for all employees. We must all operate with the shared responsibility for each other’s health & safety in mind.

About the Role:The Senior Manager Supply Chain Optimization leads the supply chain optimization capability across HUSA Operations, translating business and Operations priorities into a roadmap of cost savings, network and process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives / projects. The role is accountable for identifying and prioritizing opportunities, developing fact-based recommendations, leading complex cross-functional projects, and delivering measurable improvements in cost, service, inventory, productivity, resilience and sustainability. The role combines strong problem-solving capability, Supply Chain and analytical expertise with project leadership and stakeholder influence, while developing and establishing scalable optimization methodologies and ways of working. The role enables partnering across Planning, Warehousing, Logistics, Customer Service, Finance, Procurement and other internal and external functions to build alignment, implement transformation initiatives and embed scalable methodologies. About the Role:

The Senior Manager Supply Chain Optimization leads the supply chain optimization capability across HUSA Operations, translating business and Operations priorities into a roadmap of cost savings, network and process optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives / projects. The role is accountable for identifying and prioritizing opportunities, developing fact-based recommendations, leading complex cross-functional projects, and delivering measurable improvements in cost, service, inventory, productivity, resilience and sustainability. The role combines strong problem-solving capability, Supply Chain and analytical expertise with project leadership and stakeholder influence, while developing and establishing scalable optimization methodologies and ways of working. The role enables partnering across Planning, Warehousing, Logistics, Customer Service, Finance, Procurement and other internal and external functions to build alignment, implement transformation initiatives and embed scalable methodologies. The role also supports team and organizational capability by coaching resources, developing reusable tools and standards, and strengthening continuous improvement.



Key Responsibilities:

1. Supply Chain Optimization capability

  • Own and continuously strengthen optimization methodologies, analytical tools, scenario-planning approaches and cost-to-serve capabilities
  • Identify structural and performance opportunities across the end-to-end supply chain and convert them into a prioritized pipeline of initiatives / projects
  • Use internal and external benchmarks to identify performance gaps, challenge current ways of working and recommend improvement priorities
  • Prioritize initiatives / projects based on strategic fit, business value, feasibility, risk and resource requirements
  • Establish initiatives / projects governance, milestones, ownership and benefit tracking
  • Partner with Finance and functional Teams to validate business cases and quantify benefits

2. Network design and strategic analysis

  • Lead network and product-flow analysis across sources, ports, warehousing, transportation and customers to identify optimization and continuity opportunities
  • Develop and challenge scenario models and business cases that evaluate cost, service, inventory, capacity, risk, resilience and sustainability trade-offs
  • Provide clear recommendations to Operations Leadership and explain assumptions, alternatives, risks, resiliency, sustainability and trade-offs
  • Support strategic sourcing, footprint and network decisions with robust quantitative analysis and implementations planning

3. Performance Management and Continuous Improvement

  • Use supply chain performance data and loss deployment to identify systemic causes of cost, service and productivity gaps
  • Apply TPM continuous improvement methodology to develop sustainable solutions and embed improved ways of working

4. Stakeholder Leadership, decision influence and Team capability

  • Lead cross-functional problem solving across Planning, Logistics, Warehousing, Customer Service, Finance, Procurement and other relevant functions / Teams
  • Influence Leadership Team and key stakeholders by translating complex analysis into clear business implications, recommendations and decisions required
  • Build alignment around optimization recommendations where trade-offs exist across functions or stakeholders
  • Communicate initiatives / projects’ progress, business value, risks and opportunities to Operations Leadership and key stakeholders
  • Lead, coach, and develop optimization resources and subject-matter experts, establishing clear objectives and accountability for results
  • Delegate meaningful ownership of workstreams and orchestrate resources capable of independently leading complex initiatives
  • Build documentation, standards, governance, training materials, and knowledge-transfer practices that reduce dependency on individual experts
  • Promote a culture of curiosity, continuous improvement, accountability, business ownership, and fact-based decision making


Basic Qualifications/Requirements:

The role requires a driven and analytically minded professional with these necessary capabilities to ensure the successful delivery of the role requirements and deliver sustainable business value.

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, Business, Finance or a related discipline.
  • 5-8 years of progressive Operations / Supply Chain experience, including meaningful experience in optimization, network design, analytics, continuous improvement or transformation
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex cross-functional projects and delivering measurable business outcomes
  • Strong analytical and business-case capability, including scenario analysis, cost-to-serve, financial evaluation and benefit tracking
  • Strong project and portfolio management skills with ability to prioritize competing opportunities and drive execution through stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional leaders and translate complex analysis into clear recommendations
  • Working knowledge of modern supply chain modeling, analytics and decision-support technologies


Preferred Qualifications:

  • CPG / beverage industry experience and exposure to complex domestic or international supply chains
  • Experience with network optimization platforms, Power BI, Palantir, SAP, AI/ML or comparable digital supply chain technologies
  • APICS, IBF, Lean Six Sigma, TPM, project/program management or comparable certification
  • Experience coaching or leading analysts, managers, project teams or subject-matter experts
  • Experience supporting sourcing, footprint, logistics or major supply chain investment decisions


Compensation & Benefits:

  • Base Salary Range: $125,000 - $145,000 + Annual Bonus
  • Benefits - Medical/Dental/Vision + Matching 401k Plan
  • Vacation - 20 Days Paid Vacation & Unlimited Wellness Days
  • $200 Monthly Beverage Allowance


Heineken USA is an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes us as strong and unique as our brands. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, are or any other basis protected by law.

This position is not available for visa sponsorship.

Strengthen Data and Knowledge Foundations

Assess and improve data capture, data quality, metadata, documentation, and contextual information needed to support reliable analysis, automation, and computational modeling.Support platforms, metadata, documentation, governance, and stewardship practices that make scientific data, models, methods, assumptions, results, and technical knowledge reliable, traceable, discoverable, and reusable across projects and functional teams.

Define and track adoption, scientific outcomes, and business impact before and after deployment, including experimental efficiency, cycle-time reduction, prediction accuracy, decision quality, knowledge reuse, quality, user adoption, and project-execution performance.Develop value-realization approaches that connect digital investments to strategic priorities and measurable R&D outcomes.Communicate recommendations, trade-offs, outcomes, and success stories to R&D and enterprise leadership.

Hands-on experience applying computational or statistical models to chemistry, formulation, or process problems; deep specialist model development is supported by technical partners.Effective communication and leadership presence, with the ability to explain complex scientific and digital concepts, facilitate decisions, and engage senior leaders.Demonstrated learning agility, self-direction, and growth potential in rapidly evolving technical and organizational environments.Familiarity with regulatory requirements and quality standards applicable to scientific research, product development, and data management.

Experience shaping or delivering laboratory informatics, data, knowledge-management, or enterprise digital roadmaps.Experience applying continuous-improvement, Lean Product Development, Six Sigma, process excellence, or related methods to scientific workflows.Experience building enterprise capability and adoption programs using communities of practice, reusable learning resources, metadata, structured content, enterprise search, data governance, or AI-ready knowledge strategies.Experience developing business cases, outcome measures, or value-realization frameworks for digital investments.Demonstrated motivation to bridge R&D domain expertise with emerging digital capabilities and continuously expand technical breadth.

What’s In It For You

Annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges:

$127,075.00 - $179,400.00

This takes into account a number of factors including work location, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level & other job-related factors.

rows.headerCaptionText:

Arlington, VA
11 hours ago
57 applicants

rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

The Planogram Specialist partners with Category Leadership Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to influence, build, validate, and execute merchandising solutions that support category growth. The role co-owns planogram development, planogram specific reporting, database maintenance, and ad hoc category analytics while evolving toward stronger process leadership, standardized ways of working, and scalable tools that improve speed, quality, and consistency across divisions. The role also contributes to assortment and layout thinking by applying shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights to strengthen shelf construct recommendations, planogram testing, heat mapping, and best-practice deployment.

Responsibilities

Planogram Development & Execution

 Builds multiple versions of planograms based on pre-established assortment, clustering nuances, fixture variations, merchandising guidelines, and retailer-specific requirements, while simultaneously developing customer-specific Gold Standard POG recommendations that optimize product flow, brand blocking, adjacencies, capacity, and execution feasibility to drive immediate merchandising objectives and support long-term category growth, shopper navigation, and strategic retailer goals. Reviews, validates, and revises planograms for adherence to retailer strategy, merchandising standards, fixture /labor realities, and execution readiness. Manages relay execution for assigned categories, including workload forecasting, project coordination, deadlines, and issue resolution required for successful implementation. Provides planogram support for display merchandising where applicable, including virtual store environments, 3D product builds, video tours, promotional concepts, and customer-facing visual assets that communicate the merchandising story.

Assortment, Layout & Shelf Strategy Support

 Supports assortment and layout strategy development by translating shopper, category, retailer, and performance insights into informed shelf recommendations. Contributes to planogram testing, heat mapping, clustering evaluations, fixture alternatives, and shelf construct analysis to improve category and brand outcomes. Provides analytical support for innovation, renovation, and new item/segment display considerations as needed.

Reporting, Analytics & Decision Support

 Conducts ad hoc analytics to answer business questions from Customer Merchants, Category Advisors, Category Leadership Managers, and non-advising teams. Supports business reviews and insights development using available resources such as JDA/Blue Yonder, retailer data, and internal reporting. Measures effectiveness of planogram, assortment, and shelving actions by connecting execution outputs to performance indicators where available.

Tools, Data & Capability Enablement

 Helps develop and improve the planogram toolbox, including standardized tables, templates, reporting views, process documents, and shared knowledge resources. Identifies opportunities to test, validate, and scale tools or automation that improve planogram development, reporting, and execution efficiency. Supports onboarding, training content, and best-practice sharing for analysts, field category teams, and partners using planogram or space planning tools. Maintains strong relationship with Acosta, Shopper MX, and key internal stakeholders to optimize merchandising tools, data integrity, digital assets, and operational processes, driving efficiencies, improving execution quality, and identifying scalable, cost-effective solutions that advance category management capabilities and customer outcomes.

Collaboration & Thought Leadership

 Acts as an efficient collaborator by sharing reporting, best practices, learnings, and reusable tools across divisions and customer teams. Brings forward-thinking recommendations through proposals, planogram testing insights, heat mapping, and scalable process improvements that support total Nestlé growth. Builds trusted relationships with Category Leadership, Space Planning Management, field sales, and cross-functional partners to improve quality, speed, and alignment.

Requirements

Education & Experience

 Bachelor’s degree in related field preferred, or equivalent combination of education and experience. 2+ years of experience in Sales, Analytics, Space Management, Category Management, or a related manufacturer/retailer role; CPG and/or food industry experience a plus, with demonstrated ability to influence merchandising recommendations through buyer-facing storytelling, cross-functional partnership, and category strategy application.

Technical & Analytical Skills

 Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel; advanced analytical aptitude and ability to develop business and category knowledge, including the expertise to simplify complex data into clear visuals, shelf stories, and executive-ready recommendations. Experience with Blue Yonder/JDA Space Management preferred; ability to use SQL, Python, or similar tools to improve data extraction, analysis, or planogram workflows a plus. Ability to use retailer, marketplace, shopper, category, and performance data to address business questions and improve merchandising recommendations.

Core Capabilities

 Strong project management, prioritization, and change-management skills with the ability to manage multiple deliverables independently and in a team environment. Excellent presentation, verbal, and written communication skills with the ability to translate analysis into clear recommendations. Demonstrated initiative, tenacity, curiosity, and problem-solving; willingness to challenge current ways of working and help build future-state capabilities. Ability to collaborate across Category Leadership, Field Sales, and cross-functional partners while sharing knowledge and best practices.

Travel

Approximately 15–25% to include national meetings, local customer meetings, store visits, and other business needs.

77205124

The approximate target compensation range for this role is $75,000-90,000. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to background, knowledge, skills, and abilities as well as geographic location of the position.

Nestlé offers performance-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. Learn more at Nestlé Benefits | Nestlé Careers

It is our business imperative to remain a very inclusive workplace.

To our veterans and separated service members, you're at the forefront of our minds as we recruit top talent to join Nestlé. The skills you've gained while serving our country, such as flexibility, agility, and leadership, are much like the skills that will make you successful in this role. In addition, with our commitment to an inclusive work environment, we recognize the exceptional engagement and innovation displayed by individuals with disabilities. Nestlé seeks such skilled and qualified individuals to share our mission where you’ll join a cohort of others who have chosen to call Nestlé home.

The Nestlé Companies are equal employment opportunity employers. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Prior to the next step in the recruiting process, we welcome you to inform us confidentially if you may require any special accommodations in order to participate fully in our recruitment experience. Contact us at accommodations@nestle.com or please dial 711 and provide this number to the operator: 1-800-321-6467.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Review our applicant privacy notice before applying at https://www.nestlejobs.com/privacy.

company.name: Nestlé
company.description:
As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

rows.descriptionText:
Join L'Oréal: As the #1 beauty company in the world with 40+ brands — CeraVe, Kiehl's, Maybelline, Prada Beauty, and Redken, to name a few — we embrace diversity, sustainability, innovation, and well-being to help you shape the future of beauty.

Launch your career in the exciting world of beauty with L'Oréal's prestigious Marketing Management Trainee Program! This two-year rotational program is designed to develop the next generation of leaders within L'Oréal USA. Immerse yourself in the fast-paced world of beauty, gain hands-on experience across key functions, and build a powerful professional network. We're seeking driven, passionate graduates ready to make a real impact – are you ready to join us?

Applications reviewed on a rolling basis, September 1 – September 15. We welcome students of all backgrounds, including race, ethnicity, gender expression, LGBTQ+ status, military status, and disability status, to apply.

Who You Are

An ambitious student enrolled in a 4-year college/university, graduating December 2026 – July 2027Curious, trend-driven thinker who wants to help “create the beauty that moves the world"No prior industry experience requiredMinimum Requirements:Able to start full-time in September 2027 upon graduationLegally authorized to work in the U.S. full-time, permanently, without sponsorship now or in the futureMinimum 3.5 GPAWilling to relocate to one of our U.S. hubs: New York, NY, Clearwater, FL, or El Segundo, CA
🎯 Areas of Digital You Could Work In

Depending on your brand and team placement, you may gain hands-on exposure to:

E-Commerce Strategy – optimizing the digital shelf across Amazon, TikTok Shop, Sephora.com, and DTC sitesPerformance Marketing & Media – planning and analyzing paid social, search, and programmatic campaignsSocial Media & Community Management – managing brand presence and engagement across TikTok, Instagram, and emerging platformsInfluencer & Creator Partnerships – sourcing and activating creators to drive authentic digital reachMarketing Analytics & MarTech – using tools like GA4, Salesforce, and internal dashboards to measure digital campaign performance and ROICRM & Personalization – supporting email, loyalty, and personalized consumer journeysContent & Digital Creative – producing short-form video and digital-first creative assetsSEO & Digital Discovery – improving how consumers find brands and products online

(Note: if you're more interested in traditional brand marketing, check out our Marketing MT track instead.)

What You'll Do

Own day-to-day digital or e-commerce responsibilities — from consumer insights to campaign execution — on one of our 40+ brandsLead strategic projects from insight to recommendation, presented directly to senior leadersCollaborate cross-functionally with Digital, Supply Chain, Finance, R&I, and Sales to see how each function shapes a brand's businessBuild real business acumen by working alongside brand managers in the beauty industrySharpen your presentation, analytics, leadership, and strategic thinking skills — skills that carry into any career

The Program

Placement on a marketing team within one of L'Oréal's four divisions: Consumer Products, Luxury Products, Dermatological Beauty, or Professional ProductsFull calendar of professional development, executive networking, and social programmingPerks: 50-70% off L’Oreal brand products + access to the L'Oréal Company Store + Summer Fridays (half-day every Friday!)Housing assistance available on an individual eligibility basis per L'Oréal Relocation Policy

What's In It For You

Salary Range: $89,500 (The actual compensation will depend on a variety of job-related factors which may include geographic location)Competitive Benefit Package (Medical, Dental, Vision, 401K, Pension Plan) Being present in the office three days a week is considered an essential function of all office-based roles for eligible full-time employees. Flexible Time Off (Paid Company Holidays, Paid Vacation, Vacation Buy Program, Volunteer Time, Summer Fridays & More!) Learning & Development Opportunities (Unlimited Access to E-learnings, Lunch & Learn Sessions, Mentorship Programs, & More!) Employee Resource Groups (Think Tanks and Innovation Squads) Access to Mental Health & Wellness Programs 

Want to stand out? Join the largest youth innovation competition in the world: BRANDSTORM! Showcase your entrepreneurial spirit and be a part of the future of L'Oréal. Register now

Life’s too short for a boring career! Join L’Oreal Today

About L’Oreal

Innovation has fueled L'Oréal’s business for more than 100 years and we will rely on our culture of innovation and entrepreneurship to help us continually evolve. L'Oréal’s dynamic culture provides its employees with entrepreneurial freedom and opportunities to drive transformation across its €29.87B business, encompassing over 37 brands, around the globe. In the US, we have 12,000 employees working collaboratively across 14 states to build leading edge technologies, launch highly personalized products, reimagine consumer experiences, and develop creative solutions to reduce our environmental footprint.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At L'Oréal, we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and innovative workplace. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with the qualifications listed in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyways! You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles!

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and take pride in a diverse environment. We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, marital or veteran status, medical condition or disability, or any other legally protected status.
