Job Number #174935 - Piscataway, New Jersey, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Role Summary

The Senior Manager, Data Delivery – Global Skin Health is a pivotal role dedicated to building and scaling the core data foundation that fuels our global skin reporting and insights. In this role, you will lead the modernization of our Skin Health brands data infrastructure, transforming disparate sales, marketing, field force, and e-commerce touchpoints into unified, secure, and highly available data assets. This foundational layer serves as the definitive single source of truth for Global Skin Health brands reporting.

Work Location & Team Structure

Hybrid policy requiring 4 days per week in the office. Direct reports include 1 remote data engineering/analytics resource. 

Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership

Roadmap Alignment: Strategically align data roadmaps with Skin Health priorities to ensure that infrastructure robustly supports their goals. Technical Translation: Translate complex business requirements into scalable technical specificationsArchitecture Governance: Govern data quality and architecture standards across brands to ensure seamless integration and reliability. Strategic Integration: Partner with analytics director to ensure data development priorities are aligned with overarching 2030 strategic goals. 

Delivery & Execution

Agile/Scrum Governance: Running standups, sprint planning, and removing roadblocks for data engineers and analysts. Pipeline Management: Manage the end-to-end delivery of robust Snowflake data pipelines, leveraging modern engineering tools like dbt, SQL, and Apache Airflow for sophisticated workflow orchestration. Resource Management: Evaluate requirements to allocate internal resources and oversee external data engineering consultants, monitoring their performance and project progress. Infrastructure & Compliance: Enforce best practices for data ingestion and ensure all solutions meet security compliance and regulatory requirements to mitigate corporate risk. 

Required Experience

6+ years of hands-on experience building and scaling robust data applications within complex environments. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related technical field. 

Preferred Experience

Leadership Experience: 3+ years leading the delivery of high-impact data and analytics initiatives. Team Management: Demonstrated success in managing and mentoring remote or distributed technical talent. Data Warehouse Architecture natively utilizing Snowflake. Data Transformation Pipelines built with dbt and SQL. Workflow Orchestration using Apache Airflow. Infrastructure as Code managed via Terraform. Version Control and CI/CD automation through GitHub. 

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $140,000.00 - $174,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.

Reasonable accommodation during the application process is available for persons with disabilities. Please complete this request form should you require accommodation.

Role Summary

The Senior Manager, Data Delivery - Cross-Commercial serves as the primary technical partner to the Global Cross-Commercial Analytics team. While the business role focuses on synthesizing performance insights and strategy, this role focuses on the "how," "where," and "stability" of the data ecosystem required to achieve those insights. You are responsible for architecting, deploying, and maintaining the data infrastructure that powers our unified commercial intelligence. You will translate high-level business analytical requirements into robust data engineering solutions, ensuring that disparate data sources (Media, Pricing, Retail Media, Sales) are seamlessly integrated, and accessible.

Work Location & Team Structure

Hybrid policy requiring 4 days per week in the office. Direct reports include 2 remote data engineering/analytics resources. 

Responsibilities

Infrastructure Strategy & Integration: Lead the technical implementation of cross-commercial data foundations (e.g., Snowflake, cloud integration layers). Partner with the Global Data Foundation teams to ensure our infrastructure supports complex modeling needs like Marketing & Media Effectiveness (MME) and Revenue Growth Management (RGM). Technical Translator & Advisor: Translate evolving business KPIs, value creation frameworks, and analytical learning agendas into concrete technical requirements, data schemas, and API strategies. Strategic Capability Support: Align the technical infrastructure roadmap with the 2030 corporate strategy. Ensure that the architecture remains resilient, future-proof, and capable of integrating emerging digital commerce and retail media data sources. Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Facilitate communication between IT/Data Engineering teams and non-technical business stakeholders. Provide ongoing support for advanced analytical pilots by provisioning necessary data environments and integration points. Resource Management: Evaluate requirements to allocate internal resources and oversee external data engineering consultants, monitoring their performance and project progress. 

Required Experience

6+ years of hands-on experience building and scaling robust data applications within complex environments. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related technical field. 

Preferred Experience

Leadership Experience: 3+ years leading the delivery of high-impact data and analytics initiatives. Domain Expertise: Proven experience building sophisticated data integrations specifically for marketing and e-commerce systems. Team Management: Demonstrated success in managing and mentoring remote or distributed technical talent. Data Warehouse Architecture natively utilizing Snowflake. Data Transformation Pipelines built with dbt and SQL. Workflow Orchestration using Apache Airflow. Infrastructure as Code managed via Terraform. Version Control and CI/CD automation through GitHub.

Salary Range $140,000.00 - $174,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). rows.descriptionText:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

The Brand Marketing Operations Manager, Wholesale is responsible for managing the planning, coordination, and execution of seasonal and ongoing marketing initiatives across Wholesale Retail Partners and Family of Businesses. This role serves as a key connector across Marketing, Creative, Merchandising, Planning, Digital, and external partners to help translate marketing strategies into clear execution plans that are delivered on time and aligned to business priorities.

This role balances strong project management with hands-on operational execution, supporting marketing processes, timelines, and cross-functional workflows that enable consistent omni-channel delivery. The ideal candidate is an enthusiastic team player who is highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment.

,

Marketing Operations & Planning

 Manage end-to-end marketing workflows and timelines across the seasonal product lifecycle, from concept through execution and retail readiness. Maintain marketing calendars, hierarchy calendars, sequencing, taxonomy, and customer journey frameworks aligned to assortment, pricing, and promotional strategies. Ensure marketing plans remain aligned to final assortment, volumes by category, pricing plans, and promotional calendars, adjusting execution plans as inputs evolve. Serve as the day-to-day point of contact for marketing operational readiness across FOBs and retail partners.

Cross-Functional Execution & Alignment

 Coordinate across Marketing, Creative, Merchandising, Design, Planning, Digital, Visual, and Media teams to support integrated execution. Facilitate cross-functional milestone meetings, working sessions, and touchbases to align on inputs, outputs, ownership, and timelines. Translate marketing strategy into clear execution plans, ensuring dependencies and handoffs are understood across teams. Partner with Channel Leads and retail partners to support partner-specific execution needs while maintaining consistency and efficiency.

Campaign, Briefing & Asset Operations

 Develop and manage clear marketing and creative briefs, ensuring alignment to business objectives, product strategy, and channel requirements. Support execution readiness for omni-channel campaigns, including site experience, email/SMS, social, digital marketing, in-store signage, and partner collateral. Coordinate timelines and dependencies for creative strategy, asset development, photoshoots, content creation, and execution kickoffs. Ensure assets and deliverables are downstream-ready for launch across channels and retail partners.

Process, Budget & Operational Excellence

 Manage marketing project management tools, trackers, and operating cadences across initiatives. Partner with Directors and senior leaders to support budget tracking, timeline management, resourcing inputs, and prioritization discussions. Support invoice tracking, budget pacing, and vendor coordination to ensure operational accuracy and follow-through. Identify execution risks early and recommend solutions to keep work on track.

Performance, Insights & Continuous Improvement

 Support monthly and seasonal marketing hindsight reviews, helping synthesize insights across channels and campaigns. Partner with Merchandising, Planning, and Analytics teams to connect marketing performance insights to future seasonal planning and execution improvements. Document and apply learnings to improve process efficiency, speed-to-market, and execution quality. Contribute to the evolution of marketing best practices across FOBs and retail partners.

Salary range: $65,000 - $129,225 annually,

 6+ years of experience in marketing operations, integrated marketing, or cross-channel marketing roles. Experience managing multi-channel marketing workflows in a retail, e-commerce, or consumer brand environment. Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Demonstrated ability to partner cross-functionally with Creative, Merchandising, Planning, Digital, and external partners. Strong communication skills with the ability to translate strategy into clear, actionable plans. Experience supporting budgets, timelines, trackers, and vendor coordination.

Summary

The Senior Analyst, Business Intelligence is responsible for contributing to the development of analytical models, providing strategic reporting, and supporting performance and business decision-making by recommending system and/or process improvement solutions. This role focuses on the development, calculation, and validation of performance incentives, bonus simulations, and standard sales compensation structures, ensuring financial accuracy and alignment. Collaborating closely with cross-functional partners in Finance, HR, and Field Operations, the Senior Analyst identifies opportunities to automate data processes, streamline workflows, and eliminate manual tasks to save time for both the analyst team and business partners. Through these efforts, they translate operational data into actionable insights to optimize resources, control costs, and support overall team agility and business continuity. This is a unique opportunity for an individual with the technical skillsets and desire to analyze, transform, and build accessible, high-impact reporting for a highly driven organization.

Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

Reporting to the FP&A Lead, the FP&A Manager will serve as a strategic finance partner to Global Sourcing, Product, and Operations leadership. The role is responsible for cost center management, financial planning, and performance analytics across Italy, Turkey /Egypt/ Middle East & Americas Sourcing, Global Tech Design, Sourcing Operational Excellence and Product Integrity and other global product functions. The role also supports cross-functional transformation initiatives and strategic projects.

,

Cost Center Management & Financial Planning

 Own end-to-end financial management of assigned cost centers, including budgeting, forecasting, and month-end close Deliver variance analysis, performance reporting, and forecasting updates Consolidate and align financial inputs across regions and functions Identify risks and opportunities and partner with leadership on actions

Business Partnering & Strategic Support

 Act as a trusted finance partner to sourcing, product, and operations leadership Translate business strategies into financial plans and tradeoffs Support decision-making through financial analysis and modeling

Cost Optimization & Operational Efficiency

 Identify and drive cost optimization initiatives Support efficiency improvements across sourcing and product functions Track progress and ensure delivery of savings initiatives Quality testing tracking and reporting

Transformation & Strategic Projects

 Lead and support transformation and strategic initiatives (e.g., TNT) Provide financial oversight and value realization tracking Partner cross-functionally to deliver measurable business impact

Analytics, Reporting & Insights

 Develop and enhance financial reporting, dashboards, and analytics Deliver concise, insight-driven reporting for leadership Translate data into actionable recommendations Develop best practices in FP&A AI optimization Annual Cost to Serve Analytics and insights for Global Product organization

,

Experience

 5–8+ years of FP&A or finance experience in a multinational environment Experience supporting sourcing, product, or operational functions preferred

Technical Skills

 Strong financial modeling and analytical capabilities Advanced Excel and PowerPoint; BI tools (Power BI, Tableau) preferred

Leadership & Competencies

 Strong business partnering and stakeholder management skills Ability to operate in a global, matrixed environment Proactive, solutions-oriented mindset

Success Profile

 Strong financial control and transparency across cost centers Trusted partnership with business leadership Delivery of cost savings and efficiency improvements High-quality, forward-looking financial insights Successful execution of strategic initiatives

company.description:
As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

rows.descriptionText:
No Relocation Assistance Offered

Job Number #173812 - Piscataway, New Jersey, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

We are seeking a Senior Manager of AI Strategy & Integration to lead the adoption of Artificial Intelligence across our global Customer Development (CD) function. You will serve as the bridge between emerging AI technologies, commercial business needs, and our technical execution teams.

You will not necessarily be writing production code daily; rather, you will be the chief architect of our sales AI roadmap. Working closely with our Data Engineering and Solution Architecture teams, you will ensure our data models support advanced AI use cases and that AI capabilities are seamlessly integrated into our core sales applications (TPM, SFA/FFA, Pricing & Promo).

Work visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

What You'll Do

Strategic Roadmap Development: Create, own, and prioritize a pipeline of high-impact AI/ML use cases for the Sales function, moving the business from historical reporting to predictive and prescriptive capabilities (e.g., Trade Promotion Optimization, predictive ordering, intelligent routing). Business Evangelism & Change Management: Act as the primary AI ambassador to Sales Directors and Field Leaders. Demystify AI concepts, showcase the "art of the possible," and drive user adoption while managing expectations around delivery and data readiness. Cross-Functional Technical Leadership: Partner heavily with Data Engineers to ensure underlying data pipelines and models are primed for AI consumption. Architecture & Integration: Collaborate with Solution Architects to design how AI models will integrate seamlessly into existing off-the-shelf platforms (TPM, SFA) to deliver insights directly into the users' workflow. Technology Scouting & Vendor Management: Continuously monitor the AI landscape. Evaluate the AI roadmaps of our current software vendors and assess new tools, frameworks, and startups that fit within our broader enterprise architecture and security frameworks. Proof of Concept (PoC) Execution: Lead agile sprints to build prototypes, test prompt engineering frameworks, and validate business ROI before scaling solutions enterprise-wide. Governance & Compliance: Ensure all AI initiatives adhere to global corporate standards for data privacy, security, and responsible AI usage. 

Required Qualifications

Educational Background: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field. Experience: 7+ years of experience in IT, Data Science, or Technical Product Management, with at least 3 years focused on delivering AI, ML, or advanced analytics solutions. As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

Champion Petfoods is expanding! We are excited to announce we are looking for a Media & Digital Strategy Director to join our rapidly growing company.

We would love to hear from you if you are passionate about personal and professional growth and see yourself as a key player contributing to our continued success as an award-winning company.

Here's The Scoop – Summary

The Media & Digital Strategy Director leads development and execution of the full-funnel media and digital strategy, ensuring investment is strategically allocated to build brand awareness, drive consideration and conversion, and accelerate business growth.

This role owns media and digital engagement strategy, investment governance, integrated planning, agency leadership, and performance measurement, while continuously evolving capabilities and thought leadership across digital touchpoints for pet parent engagement.

This position is a key enabler for expanding brand awareness and driving brand relevance, while working closely with team members in Content Operations, Ecommerce, Global Insights, and Mars Global Center of Excellence.

The Director ensures an integrated approach across the pet parent research and shopping journey, ensuring creation and delivery of metrics to meet business objectives.

The Media & Digital Strategy Director works out of our Corporate office in Boulder (CO), Nashville (TN) or New York (NY) and works a hybrid schedule with 3 days in-person.

What a typical day looks like:

Full-Funnel Media Strategy. Define the media engagement strategy across awareness, consideration, conversion and advocacy, translating brand and business priorities into integrated annual strategies.Digital & Emerging Media Transformation. Lead the organization in transformation towards a digital-first pet parent model; strengthening team capabilities across media platforms, insights, and effective GEO strategies.Investment Strategy & Governance. Own the allocation and governance of media investment across brands, channels and funnel stages, establishing clear principles for prioritization, optimization and ROI.Agency Leadership & Media Excellence. Lead media agency relationships, scopes of work and performance, ensuring access to best-in-class planning, buying, innovation, technology and measurement capabilities.Measurement, Performance & Optimization. Establish a robust measurement framework across the funnel, translating media performance into actionable insights and continuously improving effectiveness, efficiency and return on investment.Audience Intelligence, Data & Personalization. Build actionable audience intelligence and segmentation to sharpen targeting, personalization and media effectiveness across the pet parent journey.Search, AI & Digital Discovery. Lead Search, SEO/GEO and AI-driven discovery strategies to maximize brand visibility, relevance and authority across evolving digital journeys.Team Leadership & Capability Building. Build and develop a high-performing Media team, strengthening future-ready capabilities across Media, Audience Intelligence, Measurement, Search and AI.

What are we looking for?

15+ years of progressive experience in Media and Digital Marketing, ideally within consumer products or DTC organizations.Deep expertise in full-funnel media strategy and planning, with strong knowledge across Brand Media, Retail Media, Search, Social, Video/CTV, Programmatic and emerging digital channels.Strong digital-first orientation, with demonstrated ability to evolve media strategies and capabilities in response to changing consumer behaviors, technology, GEO and new forms of digital discovery.Proven experience managing media investments, including budget allocation, governance and optimization across brands, channels and audiences to maximize effectiveness and ROI.Strong understanding of audience intelligence, data and measurement, with experience leveraging insights, segmentation and performance analytics to improve targeting, personalization and media effectiveness.Proven agency and partner leadership, with experience managing complex agency relationships, setting strategic direction and driving accountability, innovation and high-quality execution.Proven people leadership experience, with a track record of building, developing and inspiring high-performing teams while strengthening functional capabilities and ways of working.

What can you expect from Champion?

Safety: a strong commitment to ensure all people are provided with a safe, healthy and respectful environment.

Earnings: Salary range from USD$147,000 to USD$202,000, 401k with Company, and donation matching.

Industry Competitive Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision and Employee Assistance Programs to meet your individual or family needs.

Continuing Education: In House & Online Learning & Development, as well as an Education Assistance Program.

Quality: a dedication to uphold the highest standards of authenticity, nutritional integrity, and food safety, to earn the trust of Pet Lovers everywhere.

Other Perks: Free Bag of Premium Pet Food each month, Free Parking and more!

What are you waiting for? Join the pack!

Come as you are.

We value diversity in all forms and know the power it can bring. Workplace equality allows for creative ideas to bloom, diverse points of views to be heard, and increases overall happiness. That sounds pretty good to us.

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

As the Sr. Manager, NA Category Strategy, you'll deliver strategic thought leadership, insights, and solutions to accelerate omni growth for North America Enterprise. You will be the national shopper behavior & category expert for the Customer Development Organization and partner to the Retail Marketing Leads (Sr. BDM). This position will report to the Director of Category Management. You will be responsible for designing, facilitating, and implementing personal care/ home care/ oral care category strategies, developing processes and tools for field sales and retail customers, and influencing corporate strategy for key business areas.

This position is based out of our New York, NY office (Park Avenue) where you are expected to work in-office 4x week (Monday - Thursday).**

Responsibilities:

Leverage insights and analytics to articulate the category, segment and occasion trends will be important. Similarly, strategically plan for new, existing and exciting assortment will be necessary. You will enable the broader strategy with category partners and in partnership with customer teams. Have a track record of providing customer specific recommendations based on your ability to synthesize customer shopper data, insights & point of sale data. Represent our Customer and Field Sales teams and serve as their voice to several headquarter functions. You will ensure that the voice of our Retailers / Sales teams is represented within our strategies & plans. You will also be the voice of the category team to the field team to help clarify and build confidence in the strategic plans. Drive a strong alignment and partnership with the sales team will be key to your success. It is important to be inclusive of both the account managers and the execution leads to identify needs, timing, distribution, execution & support plans, etc. You will work on articulating, producing, and selling the annual category strategy. Demonstrate a strong ability to interpret, integrate and communicate shopper behavior, insights & POS data. You can successfully tell fact-based stories to drive Colgate & category solutions. Wwork cross-functionally across the Colgate Palmolive organization. You will have significant partnership needs across our entire Commercial Organization: Insights and Analytics, Marketing, Supply Chain, Research & Development, and Sales. Lead by influencing the agenda through collaboration, negotiation and thought leadership. It is critical for you to be able to lead a group of diverse functions and ensure they are all working towards progressive initiatives. Seek opportunities to improve and implement creative solutions. You dig into the reason behind the numbers, are able to look at the results and find out the reasons for what is driving those results and guide the team accordingly. Demonstrate an ability to think beyond single-channel execution, with a strong understanding of how we translate category strategy across both physical and digital enviroments

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree8+ years of Consumer, Shopper Insights, Shopper Behavior and/or Category Management experience Experience working with customer Shopper Behavior Data (Luminate,Dunhumby, ExtraCare, 1010, etc.) Experience working with Household Panel data (Numerator, Nielsen Panel, etc.)Experience working with a syndicated service (Nielsen, IRI) account 

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience working in consumer product goods Experience working on cross-functional teamsExperience working in omnichannel or eCom environments, with the ability to translate category strategies across physical and digital touchpoints, including exposure to digital shelf, online assortment and cross-channel executionMicrosoft Office or Google Suite proficiency (i.e, Sheets, Slides, Docs) 

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $124,000.00 - $174,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.

rows.descriptionText:
Job Location

CINCINNATI GENERAL OFFICES

Job Description

Are you energized by solving complex business challenges through a blend of analytics, consumer understanding, and strategic thinking? Do you enjoy uncovering insights from data and human behavior, then turning them into compelling stories that drive business decisions? If so, a role in Analytics & Insights (A&I) could be a great fit. In A&I, we combine analytics and insights to shape business strategy, product innovation, pricing, media investments, retail execution, and go-to-market plans.

We use our boundless curiosity to discover what consumers want, why they want it, and how we can influence them through immersive exploration, in-depth analysis, and good research. We use state of the art analytics tools to dig deep in the data, identifying key business drivers and assessing the impact of investments like advertising and in store promotions. We use big data sources and analytics to understand consumers, markets, and retailers.

The Opportunity:

As a member of the Analytics & Insights (A&I) team, you will serve as a trusted and influential internal business strategy consultant, ensuring that consumer and shopper insights are at the heart of business decisions and execution. Working closely with cross-functional partners across Brand Management, Finance, Sales, R&D, and other teams, you will identify and unlock new opportunities for business growth. Success in this role requires a unique blend of analytical expertise, strong interpersonal skills, and integrative thinking to translate research findings into actionable recommendations for key stakeholders. You will have the opportunity to explore the complexity of human behavior—from understanding decision-making processes and cognitive science to analyzing large datasets that reveal insights shaping P&G’s business strategies. Along the way, you will continuously expand your expertise by learning from internal and external thought leaders, exploring innovative approaches, and sharing knowledge across the A&I community. This is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact. We are seeking passionate, curious, and driven individuals to join our dynamic team, helping anticipate consumer needs, uncover emerging opportunities, and shape the future of our brands and business.

Key Responsibilities:

Diving into data sets to understand brand, business, and customer performance in market along with key business drivers.Utilizing Nielsen data to draw insights of performance to inform and make optimization recommendations to accelerate the business.Develop consumer insights through qualitative and quantitative learnings to guide brand business decisions and innovation.

Job Qualifications

Required: 

A Bachelors degree or higher in a quantitative field (Operation Research, Computer Science, Engineering, Applied Math, Economics, Statistics, Analytics, Management/Business Information Systems, or related degree). 5+ years of related experience. Previous experience with data management and visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, KNIME, Alterix, Tableau, Spotfire, or equivalent). Working knowledge of Market research techniques (Quantitative/Qualitative), Data platforms (e.g. Retail/Household panels), Analytics tools (Excel, Power BI, KNIME, Python/R) Experience using Microsoft Suite- Excel (pivots, formulas, charts), Powerpoint (slides visualization), Word (Written summaries and recommendations) Experience using JMP, or other statistical software Experience using visualization software and tools such as Power BI, Spotfire, or Tableau Proven mastery of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies and insight translation. Job Description



Are you energized by solving complex business challenges through a blend of analytics, consumer understanding, and strategic thinking? Do you enjoy uncovering insights from data and human behavior, then turning them into compelling stories that drive business decisions? If so, a role in Analytics & Insights (A&I) could be a great fit. In A&I, we combine analytics and insights to shape business strategy, product innovation, pricing, media investments, retail execution, and go-to-market plans.



We use our boundless curiosity to discover what consumers want, why they want it, and how we can influence them through immersive exploration, in-depth analysis, and good research. We use state of the art analytics tools to dig deep in the data, identifying key business drivers and assessing the impact of investments like advertising and in store promotions. We use big data sources and analytics to understand consumers, markets, and retailers.



The Opportunity:



As a member of the Analytics & Insights (A&I) team, you will serve as a trusted and influential internal business strategy consultant, ensuring that consumer and shopper insights are at the heart of business decisions and execution. Working closely with cross-functional partners across Brand Management, Finance, Sales, R&D, and other teams, you will identify and unlock new opportunities for business growth. Success in this role requires a unique blend of analytical expertise, strong interpersonal skills, and integrative thinking to translate research findings into actionable recommendations for key stakeholders. You will have the opportunity to explore the complexity of human behavior—from understanding decision-making processes and cognitive science to analyzing large datasets that reveal insights shaping P&G’s business strategies. Along the way, you will continuously expand your expertise by learning from internal and external thought leaders, exploring innovative approaches, and sharing knowledge across the A&I community. This is your opportunity to make a meaningful impact. We are seeking passionate, curious, and driven individuals to join our dynamic team, helping anticipate consumer needs, uncover emerging opportunities, and shape the future of our brands and business.

The Specialist, Commercial Operations - Raws Accelerator is responsible for supporting procurement, supplier operations, and inbound supply chain activities to ensure the uninterrupted supply of raw materials and packaging materials. This role maintains commercial and supplier data, supports sourcing activities, manages operational supplier relationships, and resolves supply and procurement challenges while balancing cost, service, quality, and supply continuity.

Serving as a key link between suppliers, sourcing managers, quality teams, and supply chain stakeholders, this individual monitors supplier performance, inventory levels, forecast accuracy, and commercial operations data to drive business results. Job Description:

About Mars Snacking Accelerator

Accelerator, a global Division of Mars Snacking, is on the front line of unlocking growth across high-potential categories and brands to fuel what’s next for Snacking. It’s home to both emerging and enduring brands, including KIND, TRÜ FRÜ, NATURE’S BAKERY, RXBAR, EGGO, POP-TARTS, and RICE KRISPIES TREATS. Combining the scale of Mars with the agility of a start-up, our Division has the ambition to accelerate the future of snacking by delivering products consumers love today, discovering category-shaping innovations for tomorrow, and developing entrepreneurial teams whose impact will last for generations.

We’re looking for passionate talent who dare to dream big, agile collaborators who talk straight and decide fast, and driven performers with a growth mindset. We’re proudly part of Mars, while also building something boldly different. If this inspires and energizes you, you’ve found the right place where you can do cool things with fun people for one of the biggest snacking companies in the world!

The Opportunity: Why This Role Matters

This isn’t just about running an existing operation—it’s a chance to build one. As the Sr. Manager, Commercial Operations for Packaging, you will serve as the central lynchpin and quarterback connecting Strategic Sourcing, Inbound Supply Chain, Planning, and external supplier partners across our multi-billion-dollar North American portfolio.

Stepping into a newly created role, you will architect our inbound commercial operations framework, establish new control models, and build out a dedicated team from the ground up. If you thrive on taking complex supply networks, driving cost and delivery acceleration, and turning strategic vision into daily operational reality, this is your seat at the table.

What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)

Architect & Lead the Team: Build, coach, and evolve a newly formed Commercial Operations team. Serve as the functional expert for key enterprise systems (SAP, Power BI) and establish operational playbooks and standard ways of working (WoW).Commercial Strategy & Execution: Co-develop and execute category strategies with a sharp focus on value leadership, cash flow, and total cost of ownership (TCO). Champion supplier resiliency, manage SLAs, and drive acceleration projects.Supplier Performance & Risk Management: Own the Supplier Performance Management (SPM) framework. Drive supplier accountability across OTIF delivery, quality, and service levels. Lead resiliency planning, dual-sourcing initiatives, and business continuity strategies.Inbound Value Stream Optimization: Partner closely with Planning and Logistics to optimize material flows, streamline lead times, and reduce working capital. Deliver accurate forecast visibility to suppliers and establish robust tracking metrics.Cross-Functional Integration: Serve as the core point of contact across SQA, Manufacturing, R&D, and Global Commercial partners to ensure seamless execution and delivery across all packaging streams.

What We’re Looking For

The Architect Mindset: A strategic thinker who loves building structure out of ambiguity, designing repeatable processes, and driving operational excellence from day one.Collaborative Leadership: A natural consensus-builder who communicates with clarity, challenges constructive norms, and brings cross-functional stakeholders along for the journey.Data-Driven Problem Solver: Strong analytical horsepower with the ability to dive into data, anticipate bottlenecks, resolve urgent supply issues, and build long-term sustainable solutions.Operational Depth: Proven command of logistics, inbound supply chain operations, supplier performance management, and material/packaging sourcing.

Qualifications

Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or a related field.Experience: 5–7+ years of relevant experience across supply chain operations, logistics, purchasing, or commercial sourcing.Technical Acumen: Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with SAP (or equivalent ERP/MRP systems) and proficiency in Power BI / data visualization tools.Travel: Ability to travel up to 20% as needed.

We’re looking for passionate talent who dare to dream big, agile collaborators who talk straight and decide fast, and driven performers with a growth mindset. We’re proudly part of Mars, while also building something boldly different. If this inspires and energizes you, you’ve found the right place where you can do cool things with fun people for one of the biggest snacking companies in the world!



The Opportunity: Why This Role Matters



This isn’t just about running an existing operation—it’s a chance to build one. As the Sr. Manager, Commercial Operations for Packaging, you will serve as the central lynchpin and quarterback connecting Strategic Sourcing, Inbound Supply Chain, Planning, and external supplier partners across our multi-billion-dollar North American portfolio.



Stepping into a newly created role, you will architect our inbound commercial operations framework, establish new control models, and build out a dedicated team from the ground up. If you thrive on taking complex supply networks, driving cost and delivery acceleration, and turning strategic vision into daily operational reality, this is your seat at the table.



What You’ll Do (Key Responsibilities)



  • Architect & Lead the Team: Build, coach, and evolve a newly formed Commercial Operations team. Serve as the functional expert for key enterprise systems (SAP, Power BI) and establish operational playbooks and standard ways of working (WoW).
  • Commercial Strategy & Execution: Co-develop and execute category strategies with a sharp focus on value leadership, cash flow, and total cost of ownership (TCO). Champion supplier resiliency, manage SLAs, and drive acceleration projects.
  • Supplier Performance & Risk Management: Own the Supplier Performance Management (SPM) framework. Drive supplier accountability across OTIF delivery, quality, and service levels. Lead resiliency planning, dual-sourcing initiatives, and business continuity strategies.
  • Inbound Value Stream Optimization: Partner closely with Planning and Logistics to optimize material flows, streamline lead times, and reduce working capital. Deliver accurate forecast visibility to suppliers and establish robust tracking metrics.
  • Cross-Functional Integration: Serve as the core point of contact across SQA, Manufacturing, R&D, and Global Commercial partners to ensure seamless execution and delivery across all packaging streams.



What We’re Looking For



  • The Architect Mindset: A strategic thinker who loves building structure out of ambiguity, designing repeatable processes, and driving operational excellence from day one.
  • Collaborative Leadership: A natural consensus-builder who communicates with clarity, challenges constructive norms, and brings cross-functional stakeholders along for the journey.
  • Data-Driven Problem Solver: Strong analytical horsepower with the ability to dive into data, anticipate bottlenecks, resolve urgent supply issues, and build long-term sustainable solutions.
  • Operational Depth: Proven command of logistics, inbound supply chain operations, supplier performance management, and material/packaging sourcing.



Qualifications



  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business, or a related field.
  • Experience: 5–7+ years of relevant experience across supply chain operations, logistics, purchasing, or commercial sourcing.
  • Technical Acumen: Minimum of 3 years of hands-on experience with SAP (or equivalent ERP/MRP systems) and proficiency in Power BI / data visualization tools.
  • Travel: Ability to travel up to 20% as needed.

We invest heavily in cutting-edge research, leveraging advanced technologies to understand skin, hair, and microbiome, while discovering new active ingredients and launching outperforming formulas. Our 3,500 L'Oréal R&I experts leverage Science & Technology to invent safe, trustable, sustainable & responsible beauty products and experiences that will change people’s lives.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

As AI Transformation Lead for Colgate Global Supply Chain, you are the primary driver of AI execution on the ground. You will work with the Enterprise AI team to set the strategic direction for Horizontal and Vertical AI priorities, and you own execution and value for your organization. This includes scaling strategic initiatives, surfacing the highest-value use cases back to the global pipeline, and capturing financial value for reinvestment.

You are also the first line of offense for AI adoption, serving as the hands-on force directly training your teams and orchestrating your regional network of AI Ambassadors. You cultivate your own AI skills with the latest CP tools, and advise your organization on emerging opportunity areas, in concert with enterprise partners & plans.

Responsibilities

Scale Vertical AI Initiatives Execute enterprise strategic AI initiatives within your division or function, translating global priorities into locally relevant programs that drive tangible business value across brands and markets. Lead Divisional/Functional Priorities Map and assess the division's/function’s unique workflows to identify where AI can fundamentally change how work is done. Establish and execute top priorities to compliment enterprise Vertical priorities. Surface and Share High-Value Use Cases Continuously identify, validate, and share the most impactful AI opportunities within your organization — feeding a live pipeline of use cases back to your AI Transformation peers and the enterprise AI team to inform enterprise-wide scaling priorities. Drive Horizontal AI Utilization Lead hands-on AI training and enablement for your divisional workforce. Use your own adept skills with advanced AI tools (Gemini, notebookLM, etc) to build training and create valuable and ‘sticky’ use-cases and drive high-value utilization. Orchestrate Regional AI Ambassadors Coordinate and energize your network of AI Ambassadors, aligning their efforts with divisional priorities, running training and enrichment activities, and ensuring consistent execution and momentum across hubs/sub or sub-functions. Capture AI Value Track and report the tangible value generated (both FTG and growth opportunities) by AI initiatives within your division/function. Establish consistent reporting cadences with your organizational leadership, and create feedback loops so data-driven insights continuously sharpen strategy and execution. Local Risk & Governance Lead Serve as the primary safeguard for AI risk and compliance within your division/function. Partner with the Global AI Governance team to ensure all local initiatives meet global standards and regional regulations (e.g., EU AI Act, local data privacy laws).

Job Description:

Accelerator, a global Division of Mars Snacking, is on the front line of unlocking growth across high-potential categories and brands to fuel what’s next for Snacking. It’s home to both emerging and enduring brands, including KIND, TRÜ FRÜ, NATURE’S BAKERY, RXBAR, EGGO, POP-TARTS and RICE KRISPIE TREATS. Combining the scale of Mars with the agility of a start-up, our Division has the ambition to accelerate the future of snacking by delivering products consumers love today, discovering category-shaping innovations for tomorrow and developing entrepreneurial teams whose impact will last for generations.

We’re looking for passionate talent who dare to dream big, agile collaborators who talk straight and decide fast, and driven performers with a growth mindset. We’re proudly part of Mars, while also building something boldly different. If this inspires and energizes you, you’ve found the right place where you can do cool things with fun people for one of the biggest snacking companies in the world!

The ODD Lead, Digital Commerce leads Accelerator's On-Demand Delivery and Marketplace Commerce agenda, with responsibility for driving strategy, execution, analytics, and performance across last-mile delivery platforms, marketplaces, and emerging commerce models.

This role will support the Accelerator business across brands including KIND®, RXBAR®, Nutri-Grain®, Special K Bars®, Pure Organic®, Eggo®, Rice Krispies Treats®, and Pop-Tarts®, with a focus on accelerating growth across platforms such as Instacart, Amazon, DoorDash, Uber Eats, GoPuff, and DashMart.

As the Accelerator division continues to evolve, this role will help build the commercial and operating muscle needed to win in digital commerce. The ODD Lead will translate platform performance, shopper behavior, retail media learnings, and customer opportunities into scalable strategies, repeatable playbooks, and clear execution models that can be applied across brands, customers, and markets.

This role will also serve as a key connector into the broader Mars Snacking Digital Commerce and Route-to-Market ecosystem, helping ensure Accelerator is both adopting and shaping global best practices across On-Demand Delivery, marketplaces, digital merchandising, retail media, performance marketing, and connected commerce. The role is expected to build capability by transforming successful customer programs, platform partnerships, and test-and-learn initiatives into scalable growth models and best practices.

Job Responsibilities

Lead omni-commerce analytics, sales performance reporting, forecast attainment, share growth, and performance optimization across key digital commerce, marketplace, and last-mile delivery platforms.Develop and execute commercial strategies across Instacart, DoorDash, Uber Eats, GoPuff, DashMart, and emerging commerce platforms to accelerate growth, improve conversion, and expand household penetration.Co-lead digital merchandising, digital shelf, retail media, marketplace activation, and connected commerce strategies, ensuring platform execution is linked to broader brand, customer, and commercial priorities.Build scalable playbooks, execution standards, and test-and-learn models across On-Demand Delivery, marketplaces, retail media, digital merchandising, and last-mile activation, with the ability to scale learnings across Accelerator brands and into broader Mars Digital Commerce forums.Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Finance, Category Leadership, Retail Media, Customer Teams, and Global Digital Commerce partners to align priorities, remove barriers, and deliver shared commercial outcomes.Support joint business planning with strategic platform partners, including identifying added-value media opportunities, bespoke insights, commercial unlocks, and tri-party arrangements across customers, platforms, and brands.Serve as a subject matter expert and global capability connector, bringing external platform expertise and internal Mars best practices together to shape how Accelerator wins across evolving commerce models.Communicate complex platform, media, and performance insights to senior leaders, cutting through the noise to surface the “so what,” commercial opportunity, and recommended action.

Qualifications

Required

5+ years of experience in CPG, Sales, Digital Commerce, Shopper Marketing, Retail Media, Category Management, or a related commercial function.2+ years of experience managing commercial strategies, customer relationships, or media execution across last-mile delivery platforms such as Instacart, DoorDash, Uber Eats, or similar partners.Strong understanding of digital commerce growth levers, including assortment, content, search, digital shelf, retail media, promotions, loyalty, marketplace execution, and performance analytics.Proven ability to translate data, customer insights, and platform performance into clear commercial strategies and action-oriented recommendations.Demonstrated ability to influence outcomes across functions, seniority levels, and stakeholders without complete authority.

Preferred

Experience managing retail media investments and optimization strategies that drive measurable sales, share, and conversion outcomes.Experience developing connected commerce, digital shelf, marketplace, or omni-channel growth strategies across grocery, drug, dollar, discount, pure-play, or delivery-based retail partners.Experience supporting or leading joint business planning, strategic customer negotiations, added-value media opportunities, and test-and-learn programs.Experience working in a global, regional, or highly matrixed environment, with the ability to translate local market execution into scalable enterprise best practices.Entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving organizations and build capabilities from the ground up.

What To Expect From Mars

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

The base pay range for this position at commencement of employment is between the range listed below, however, base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including but not limited to job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The total compensation package for this position will include variable pay, medical and dental benefits, participation in 401k plan, and paid time off benefits. Details of participation in these benefit plans will be provided if an applicant receives an offer of employment.

rows.descriptionText:
About The Job

The Senior Product Owner – Supporting Functions is responsible for defining and driving the product vision, roadmap, prioritization, and value realization for a portfolio of products supporting key enterprise functions, including FP&A, Danone Business Services (DBS), Human Resources (HR), and General Services (GS).

Partnering closely with business leaders, IT & Data teams, and external providers, this role translates business needs into scalable digital solutions that enhance operational efficiency, process standardization, data quality, employee experience, and business performance.

As the strategic owner of a medium-to-high complexity product domain, the Senior Product Owner balances competing priorities, manages cross-functional dependencies, and ensures the successful delivery and adoption of products that drive measurable business value. The role requires strong stakeholder management, product leadership, and the ability to connect diverse functional needs with technology-enabled solutions across a regional and global environment.

About You

Education & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, Human Resources, Technology, Data, or a related field. 5–8+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Enterprise Applications, Technology Delivery, or related business partnering roles. Experience managing products or platforms supporting Finance, HR, Shared Services, Corporate Functions, or other enterprise business processes. Proven experience working in agile environments, managing backlogs, roadmaps, and cross-functional delivery teams. Experience operating in regional or global organizations with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities. 

Technical & Functional Skills

Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, product lifecycle management, backlog prioritization, roadmap planning, and value delivery. Experience with enterprise platforms and ecosystems supporting Finance, HR, workflow, reporting, governance, and shared services. Familiarity with ERP, HRIS, planning, reporting, analytics, service management, document management, and integration platforms. Strong understanding of business process optimization, data quality, system integrations, user adoption, and change management principles. Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, SAP, Workday, ServiceNow, Power BI, or comparable enterprise solutions. Ability to evaluate solution alternatives, dependencies, technical constraints, and business impacts to drive informed product decisions. 

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

Strong business acumen and ability to understand complex functional priorities across Finance, DBS, HR, and General Services. Proven ability to translate business needs into product strategies, roadmaps, and measurable outcomes. Excellent communication, influencing, stakeholder management, negotiation, and facilitation skills. Strong leadership through influence with a collaborative and servant leadership mindset. Ability to make informed trade-offs balancing business value, user needs, cost, complexity, and delivery timelines. Strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities and results orientation. Comfortable navigating ambiguity, managing competing priorities, and driving alignment across diverse stakeholder groups. Customer- and user-centric mindset with a strong focus on adoption, experience, and value realization. 

Language Requirements

Fluent English required. Spanish preferred. Portuguese is a plus. 

About us

At Danone Mexico, we work with a deep conviction people's health and the health of the planet are connected. Under our global vision One Planet. One Health., we build a healthier future through food and beverages that are part of the daily lives of millions of families worldwide.

In Mexico, with more than 15,000 employees, 35 plants, and over 100 distribution centers across the country, we are a diverse and highly committed community driving iconic brands such as Danone, Activia, Oikos, Danonino, Bonafont, and Silk. Every person who joins us brings a key piece to continue evolving and innovating.

At Danone, you will find an environment where you can grow with purpose and be authentic. We value what each person contributes, and it is this combination of experiences, talents, and perspectives that strengthens our culture and drives us to achieve extraordinary results. Here, you will have the freedom to propose, create, and bring ideas to life that generate real impact.

We foster your development through continuous feedback, clear objectives, agile methodologies, and learning tools designed to accelerate your professional growth. We want you to move forward with confidence and find a path that inspires you. Your well-being is also fundamental to us. That’s why we offer flexible benefits, comprehensive health programs covering physical, emotional, and financial well-being, support platforms, exclusive discounts, and benefits above the legal requirements—supporting you at every stage of your life.

We are proudly a B Corp certified company, reflecting our commitment to responsible practices, conscious decisions, and a positive impact on people, communities, and the planet.

If you are looking for a place where you can contribute, grow, and be part of a community driven by purpose, we invite you to explore our opportunities and discover for yourself everything you can build at Danone. Your next big professional step could start here.

Job Summary

At Danone, Manufacturing the best products and supplying them to meet demand is a key driver for our plant teams. We are currently looking to hire a Quality Systems Coordinator based in Dallas, Texas at our Beverage & Plant based manufacturing facility!


Key Responsibilities

As a key member of our Dallas Texas Plant team, you will play an important role in driving our mission forward. The Quality Systems Coordinator will support the implementation of the Danone Quality Assurance standards through technical guidance, analysis, and leadership to continuously improve quality performance. The Quality Systems Coordinator is accountable for capability assessment and improvement in the areas of food safety controls, programs, systems, audit preparedness, product specification performance.


The following responsibilities outline the core expectations and contributions for this position

  • Support and assist PQA Manager with the coordination, updates, and maintenance of the FSHCP, HACCP system, & all QFS management systems.
  • Lead and coordinate audits (Internal & external) such as, FSSC, kosher, organic, US Military, RSPO, GFCO, customers, etc. including developing responses, CAPA’s, and driving audit closure.
  • Ensure continuous improvement of the QFS processes, plans, and practices
  • Responsible for the effectiveness of the plant Quality documentation system
  • Traceability Program champion and owner. Schedule and train traceability team on all types of traces required by both GFSI, Danone, and Local traceability procedures. Including identification and resolution of any gaps found.
  • Ensure all employees are included in the QFS training programs, including all FSMS trainings and CampusX content.
  • Primary driver of the culture of quality mindset and desired behaviors at the plant specifically as the iCare program owner
  • Support the QFS digitalization of the plant programs and results
  • Support and assist PQA Manager with data collection, trending results and KPI’s completion for management review and continuous improvement.
  • QI Piller owner and primary driver of initiatives, supporting the IWS journey of the Quality standards of the plant
  • Food Fraud Coordinator for the site. Own and oversee the Food Fraud program for the site – SPOC for audits, maintain Food Fraud programs.
  • Back-up Food Defense Coordinator for the site working with EHS department to ensure Food Defense program is maintained.
  • Support the optimization of processes and product costs aimed at eliminating losses resulting from products not meeting their specifications
  • SPOC for contracted Pest Control Program on site.
  • All other duties as assigned

Physical Demands

  • This role requires standing for extended periods and lifting up to 25 lbs.

Work Environment

  • Work is performed in a manufacturing environment with exposure to moderate noise and temperature variations.
  • Work schedules could include nights, weekends and/or holidays to provide the ability to support a 24/7 manufacturing environment as business needs dictate. Work schedules could include off-shift or weekends

Engagement in our Integrated Work Systems

Ensure adherence to plant standards and procedures (including but not limited to GMP, AIB, FDA, IWS, Quality, Safety, Finance, ISO, HOPE, Danone Behaviors, Daily Direction Setting, Driving OE). As a fundamental piece of the organization, your responsibility is to participate and own the implementation and deployment of IWS system and its pillars (Leadership foundation, Daily Direction Setting, Driving OE; Autonomous Maintenance; planned Maintenance; Focused Improvement; Education and Training; Environmental, Health and Safety; Quality; Organization; Supply Network; Early Equipment Management) with the objective of owning your space, owning your performance (Safety, Quality, Cost, Delivery, Mobilization, Nature) and owning your continuous improvement.


Compensation & Benefits

Danone North America additionally offers a performance-based bonus and has a strong benefits package including Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Coverage, 401k Plan, Wellness Program, Life Insurance, Tuition Reimbursement, Flexible Time Off, and Paid Parental Bonding Leave, among other benefit plan options.


About You

The ideal candidate will bring a combination of education, experience, and skills that enable them to excel in this position. The following qualifications outline what we’re looking for, including both required and preferred criteria

Education & Experience

  • B.S. in Food Science or Food Technology, Microbiology, Pharmacy, Biotechnology or related science related fields
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience within Quality Assurance or related fields in food manufacturing or regulatory related function in food, pharmaceutics, medical devices or biotechnology
  • Working experience in a processing & manufacturing environment.
  • Strong Beverage, Dairy, Plant Based Product Category experience preferred, or high risk, ready to eat categories.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Strong Business & People Leadership Competencies demonstrated in previous roles with a passion to develop and grow others.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, leadership, interpersonal, and training skills
  • Ability to influence others and be a team player
  • Very good knowledge of the applicable Q&FS management systems (ISO, FSSC 22000, PRP’s, HACCP, GMP, GHP, etc.) and the application thereof.
  • Trained and experienced in auditing & project management
  • Solid experience in Quality & Food Safety Management Systems
  • Good technical understanding of food science & technology, formulation, processing & equipment
  • Good Knowledge of food, food safety legislation, regulations and issues
  • Very good knowledge of statistical evaluation
  • Experience with Data analytics and digital fluency graphs, tables, PBI, LIMS, SAP

About us

Danone U.S. is part of Danone North America, a purpose-driven company and an industry leader in the food and beverage category. You’ll work with some of the best-known food and beverage brands in the world. Our strong portfolio of brands includes Activia®, DanActive®, Danimals®, Dannon®, evian®, Follow Your Heart®, Happy Family® Organics, International Delight®, Light + Fit®, Nutricia ®, Oikos®, Silk®, So Delicious® Dairy Free, STōK® Cold Brew Coffee ®, Too Good & Co™, and YoCrunch®.


With approximately 5,000 employees and 13 production locations across the U.S., Danone North America's mission is to bring health through food to as many people as possible.

You’ll be part of one of the largest Certified B Corps™ in the world, working to make sure our company creates real value for people and the planet. Come join our movement for a healthier world One Planet. One Health BY YOU.
