No Relocation Assistance Offered

Job Number #175979 - New York, New York, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Global People professionals are consistently drawn to Colgate-Palmolive by the exceptional opportunities for career advancement and a strong alignment with our globally recognized, purpose-driven brand. While we offer competitive total rewards, new team members frequently highlight our welcoming company culture and the high caliber of the people they work alongside as primary reasons for joining our team. Within our Global People function, we foster a culture of high trust and autonomy, ensuring you feel empowered to make impactful decisions and directly influence our broader strategic priorities while you build a fulfilling, long-term career.

As a member of the People Experience team, you will be the heartbeat of the employee journey, owning the local execution of global People programs and creating an inclusive environment where everyone can perform at their best and reach their full potential. You will be the primary partner for employees and managers in the North America Division's Finance, Marketing & Colgate Oral Pharmaceuticals (COP) functions, translating HR policies into practical solutions and driving operational excellence across the region. This is a unique opportunity for you to gain broad exposure across diverse businesses and HR activities while influencing the growth and development of our global workforce.

Responsibilities:

Executing critical global People programs, including performance management, talent planning, learning & development and compensation, in close partnership with People Business Partners and Center of Excellence teams. Supporting the People Experience team to implement new global programs in the context of the business and region with CoE teams. Ensuring high quality experience around the "moments that matter" within the employee lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, and key career transitions. Coaching and advising managers on employee relations, performance management, career development, and leadership capabilities to elevate team performance and engagement. Managing employee relations cases applying sound judgment and conflict resolution with Legal and business stakeholders. Partnering with Ethics & Compliance on investigations to maintain a positive and inclusive work environment. Utilizing data analytics and organizational diagnostics to identify trends and translate insights into actionable solutions for the business. Driving continuous improvement by identifying operational bottlenecks and leveraging AI and digital tools to optimize HR service delivery. Providing on-the-ground-feedback and insights to People Business Partners, CoE, and CBS- ensuring the broader People function remains connected to what is happening across the organization. Participating in agile Global People projects and initiatives. 

Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree Minimum of 3 years of relevant human resources experience. Demonstrated ownership in managing competing priorities and timelines to accomplish overlapping activities. 

Preferred Qualifications:

Advanced degree or professional HR certification (e.g., SHRM-CP, PHR). Experience in the CPG or FMCG industry implementing scalable HR processes and global programs within a multi-national environment. Strong advisory skills to coach managers and employees. Advanced emotional intelligence and conflict resolution skills to manage complex employee relations. Experience with identifying gaps and driving continuous improvement for HR programs and initiativesDemonstrated proficiency in managing stakeholders across the HR function or across multiple functions. Demonstrated ability to manage change and navigate ambiguity in a fast-paced, matrixed organization and manage multiple HR initiatives with high detail orientation. Proven proficiency in leveraging AI, data analytics, and HR technologies (e.g., self-service portals) to drive insights and workflow optimization. 

Work visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Accordingly, all applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis and must not require the Company's sponsorship to continue to work legally in the United States.

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $97,000.00 - $120,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.

Reasonable accommodation during the application process is available for persons with disabilities. Please complete this request form should you require accommodation.

rows.descriptionText:
Foods you love. Brands you trust. And a career that empowers you to grow.

At Nestlé USA, we’re all working towards the same goal – to delight and deliver for our consumers. With a rich portfolio of beloved brands, including DiGiorno, Toll House, and Coffee mate, in 97% of U.S. households, we have a unique opportunity – and responsibility – to be there for every moment in our consumers’ lives.

Joining Nestlé means becoming part of an inclusive workplace that inspires innovation, encourages strategic thinking and creativity, and celebrates your achievements. No matter where you work within the organization, you are empowered to challenge the status quo, embrace risk-taking, and pioneer new ideas. Our supportive and collaborative environment encourages bold ambitions and continuous learning so that everyone can grow and thrive.

This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.

Position Overview:

As the largest food & beverage company in the world, we sell over a billion products every day. Nestle’s sales team is the driving force behind every unit sold, focused on building strong categories by delighting our consumers while representing Nestle’s iconic brands with our retail partners.

The Sales Analytics team is the analytical intelligence engine that powers our sales team. The insights, data, and analytical expertise that our Sales Analysts provide shape our strategic business decisions and equip our sales team to meet our consumer needs and drive category growth. As a Frozen Sales Analyst, you’ll be an integral member of the account team, collaborating with Customer Account Manager(s) to meet our collective sales objectives and drive market share for Nestle’s brands.

Key Responsibilities:

The Sales Analyst is the analytical expert for the customer team they support. Analysts advise our sales team by leading the facilitation of best-in-class data, insights, reporting, and analysis. Key responsibilities include:

Proactively generate actionable insights that support the current business needs, inform strategic decisions, and drive profitable brand and category performance.Provide analytical recommendations and identify opportunities through the utilization of syndicated data (Circana, Nielsen, point of sale) and other data resources.Exhibit category expertise by maintaining a comprehensive understanding of the category and the broader business landscape.Utilize data visualization and effective storytelling to help build sales presentations.Build & maintain 4P reporting & tools that are essential to the day-to-day operation of Nestle’s customer account teams.Pull data for ad hoc analysis from various sources including syndicated data, retailer platforms, and internal resources.

Requirements:

As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

Job Description:

The Senior National Account Manager plays a crucial role in driving profitable and sustainable sales growth for the Mars Food Business across Ben’s Original, Seeds of Change and Tasty Bite brands. This position is responsible for maintaining strong relationships with customers, broker partners, and internal stakeholders, ensuring the execution of innovative customer plans that support key business objectives in revenue, profit, growth, distribution, shelving, merchandising, promotions, and pricing.

As the primary account lead for Walmart, this role is directly accountable for delivering the financial plan, driving key growth initiatives, managing trade funding, fostering category leadership, and overseeing Top-to-Top customer engagement and retail execution. A strong focus will be placed on accelerating organizational growth, increasing household penetration, and expanding category leadership through strategic partnerships with customers.

We are looking for a strategic, data-driven, and results-oriented leader with a deep understanding of Walmart, consumer trends, and the CPG industry. The ideal candidate will have strong enterprise leadership skills that embody Mars’ 5 Principles, fostering collaboration and leading crucial conversations with internal and external partners to drive focus, alignment, and business results.

What are we looking for?

5+ years of consumer-packaged goods (CPG) retail sales experience 3+ years of Walmart sales management experience (preferred) Proven retail analytic application & management capabilities, i.e. syndicated data (Nielsen and/or IRI), customer specific data (Luminate/Scintilla), and annual customer planning Category Management and Customer/Trade Marketing/SRM(RGM) experience Strong Microsoft Office (PowerPoint, Excel & Word) capabilities Ability to travel a minimum of 10% of the time Valid driver’s license and clean driving record 

What will be your key responsibilities?

Deliver the operating plan - Achievement of customer growth and profit objectives.  Market share, NSV, operating profit, ROI on Trade Develop sales strategy - for Ben’s Original and Seeds of Change to drive long term growth objectives. Recommend and set priorities as part of segment review process. Sell Mars Food category vision (D,S,M,P) to customers, maximizing sales growth and profit. Manage joint business plan development and execution, including annual collaborative planning meetings Manage overall customer P&L, delivering financial commitments including GSV, NSV and Trade. Accomplished by levering tools and resources (technology and people) to negotiate effective customer programs along with effective tracking of all promotional contracts with our customers Responsible for sales forecast. Leveraging S&OP best practices and tools in partnership with the demand planning team Leverage internal resources to support business objectives (i.e, category management, customer support, shopper marketing, omni-commerce and consumer marketing) Leverage broker partner support (i.e. syndicated retail coverage, incremental analytic support, back office) Develop and execute breakthrough customer engagement plans, connecting leadership between customers and senior leadership at Mars Food. Maintain consistent stakeholder updates (internal and external stakeholders), including internal customer plans. 

What can you expect from Mars?

Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

Capability Building & Site Enablement

Governance, Compliance & Controls

Ensure all system changes align with quality, safety, and internal control standardsMaintain system security through access controls, audits, and periodic refreshesFollow escalation protocols and ensure issues are addressed at the appropriate levelEnsure adherence to standardized work processes and governance frameworks

Project & Continuous Improvement Leadership

Support and lead deployment of key initiatives and projects leveraging PrIMEIdentify opportunities for loss elimination and process optimization, and drive implementation within area of influence to improve system reliability and operational outcomes.Provide input into future system capabilities based on operational needs and business priorities

Nestlé’s Research & Development Center is our regional powerhouse driving innovation in food, beverage, and pharmaceutical science. Backed by our global Nestlé R&D organization, we lead breakthrough discoveries that are both good for consumers and the planet. Our team of experts range from product developers to engineers, working across our portfolio of food, beverage, infant nutrition, and health science to create leading-edge products and services. As part of our organization, you will use your entrepreneurial spirit and commitment to excellence to unlock the power of food and provide premium value.



This position is not eligible for Visa Sponsorship.



Position Summary



We are seeking an innovative and forward-thinking Sr Specialist Process Engineer to drive the conceptualization, design, prototyping, and piloting of new manufacturing solutions for the Frozen Food Division. In this role, you will serve as the technical expert responsible for developing frozen food manufacturing technologies, ensuring that both new and existing processes can be successfully implemented at full scale to improve cost, quality, safety, and operational efficiency across the Frozen network. There are 2 Process Engineer openings. One for Pizza and one for Meals.



Key Responsibilities



  • Be a leader in the implementation of the Nestle R&D Engineering in the definition of standards, best practices and continuous improvement.
  • Develop, validate, and optimize mixing, cooking, assembly, mechanical, and freezing processes related to all aspects of frozen food production.
  • Codify and formalize proven solutions into Frozen Food standards to enable effective deployment, competency building and replication across factories.
  • Scale processes from proof of concept and pilot runs to full factory implementation, ensuring throughput, quality, consistency, and repeatability.
  • Lead troubleshooting and root cause analysis to resolve processing issues and eliminate variability.
  • Develop automated manufacturing solutions that improve labor efficiency, process consistency, product quality, and scalability across the Frozen network.
  • Partner with automation and controls specialists to ensure processing systems integrate with plant PLC/SCADA and DMO platforms.
  • Support development of process simulations and digital twins to optimize throughput and operational efficiencies.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using data analytics, advanced modeling, and process insights.
  • Execute plant trials, commissioning activities, and capability studies, ensuring processes are validated and ready for scale‑up.
  • Collaborate with OEMs and internal stakeholders to deliver robust, scalable processing solutions.
  • Work with R&D teams to conduct pilot plant trials that ensure superior product quality and alignment with product requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with food safety, industrial safety, and cybersecurity requirements.



Leadership Expectations



  • Influence cross-functional teams through deep technical expertise and sound engineering judgment.
  • Provides coaching and mentorship to Factory Engineers and Project Teams.
  • Strong problem‑solving, communication, and cross‑functional leadership skills.
  • Collaborate effectively with R&D, Corporate Engineering, Frozen Operations, TAG, Quality, and Manufacturing Excellence to achieve aligned business outcomes.



Required Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s required in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering Industrial Engineering, or related field. Masters preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in process engineering within frozen foods or process-related industries.
  • Experience scaling processes from pilot to commercial manufacturing.
  • Strong understanding of cooking, blending, freezing technologies, filling and relevant unit operations.
  • Experience with simulation tools (FlexSim or equivalent) preferred.
  • Experience with AutoDesk 3D design preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 30%



Salary: $97,294.50 to $133,112 per year



Bonus Eligibility: 7%

company.description:
As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

This highly visible role is responsible for leading a high-performing team to manage the Colgate-Grocery and HIPE customers’ supply chain. The Manager ensures Colgate’s portfolio remains consistently available, meets service level goals, and aligns with customer´s business priorities by fostering a motivated, collaborative environment.

Accountable for inventory, in-stock performance, and supply chain execution, you wiill work closely with customers’ buying and replenishment teams as well as internal Colgate partners to deliver seamless end-to-end planning and execution. Lead, mentor, and develop the Grocery and HIPE’s customer-specific team of 3 people, championing open communication and creating a collaborative, goal-driven environment. Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement, modeling Colgate’s leadership values in all interactions. Manage team workload and goals to align with current and future account requirements, ensuring optimal support coverage across all product categories. Leverage data analytics and reporting tools to optimize replenishment, minimize out-of-stocks, and support business reviews and Joint Business Planning (JBP) with key customers in Grocery and HIPE Retail environments. Drive process improvements and supply chain efficiency projects, ensuring Colgate products meet or exceed customer expectationsWork closely with the Customer Experience Analytics team to ensure there is a full data integration using customers’ data and our internal data to identify gaps and capture opportunities. 

What you need for this position:

BS/BA in Business, Supply Chain, or related field10+ years of experience in CPG supply chain, with a preference managing replenishment activities with major retailers. Proven experience in leading and developing teamsExpert understanding of replenishment, forecasting, and inventory management—preferably in the (health/beauty) categoryStrong analytical skills and proficiency with Excel, Google Sheets, SQL or similar reporting tools

It’s an advantage to have:

DOMO, Sigma, Snowflake, Google Data StudioSAP/Kinaxis System knowledgeExcellent communication and relationship-building skills, able to simplify complex issues for cross-functional partners and retailer stakeholderAbility to influence and build strong partnerships with both internal teams and customers at various levelsTrack record of delivering operational excellence and driving process improvement

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $124,000.00 - $174,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

No Relocation Assistance Offered

Job Number #173393 - Piscataway, New Jersey, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

As a Principal Scientist you will serve as a central technical resource supporting the entire global Colgate-Palmolive portfolio by developing and validating state-of-the-art analytical platforms to characterize complex product matrices. Operating within the global R&D organization, you will act as the technical arbiter of "Truth," ensuring that every chemical claim made by Marketing is backed by statistically rigorous, peer-reviewed-quality data. This role offers an exciting opportunity to spearhead Lab 4.0 digital transformations, run advanced competitive teardowns, and defend the company's intellectual property. Your primary objective will be to provide flawless analytical characterization that guarantees formulation parity, regulatory compliance, and consumer safety across all product categories.

Responsibilities

Advanced Method Development: Designs and validates novel analytical protocols for active and critical inactive ingredients, stabilizers, and sensory molecules using high-resolution LC/GC MS and NMR technologies. Crisis Chemistry & Forensic Analysis: Leads proactive monitoring and "Rapid Response" forensics for trace contaminants, conducting root-cause analysis on stability failures or manufacturing deviations to ensure safety amid supply chain shifts. Deformulation & Competitive Intelligence: Conducts competitive product teardowns to break down rival formulations to their base molecules, utilizing non-targeted analysis (NTA) workflows to structurally identify unknown components, and evaluates optimized ingredients from new suppliers to ensure absolute formulation parity. Claim Substantiation & Legal Defense: Partners with Marketing and Legal teams to transform analytical results into "Visual Science" for claim validation, ensuring all methods meet AOAC, USP, or ISO standards to remain legally unassailable. Lab 4.0 & Digital Transformation: Evaluates high-throughput tools, oversees the implementation of MS Imaging platforms, and collaborates with Digital R&D to build automated data processing pipelines, feeding mass spec chemometric and big data into predictive Machine Learning models. Sustainable Packaging Interface: Develops standardized methodologies including ultra-trace extractables and leachables (E&L) screening to investigate chemical interactions between formulas and new sustainable or recycled packaging materials to ensure zero migration of impurities. 

Required Qualifications

PhD in Analytical, Organic, or Medicinal Chemistry10 years of advanced laboratory experience. Expert-level knowledge of High-Resolution LC-MS and GC-MS for content quantification and structure elucidation. Technical proficiency in spectroscopic techniques including FTIR, Raman, and NMR as supporting tools for understanding molecular interactions within a formula. Proven experience working within a GxP (GLP/GMP) regulated environment with a strong understanding of data "Chain of Custody" protocols. 

Preferred Qualifications

Specialized experience in Microbiome Analytics, including metabolomics or analyzing bacterial metabolites in complex biological samples. Demonstrated background in "Green Chemistry" analytics, such as assessing the biodegradability of surfactants or the purity of post-consumer recycled packaging. Strong collaborative capacity to translate complex analytical big data into actionable business strategies for cross-functional stakeholders. Proven ability to support IP activities and patent filings by providing detailed molecular characterization data for new entities. 

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $124,000.00 - $180,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Colgate is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, ethnicity, age, disability, marital status, veteran status (United States positions), or any other characteristic protected by law.

Reasonable accommodation during the application process is available for persons with disabilities. Please complete this request form should you require accommodation.

Qualifications

company.description:
As the world’s largest food and beverage company we are driven by a simple aim: unlocking the power of food to enhance quality of life for everyone, today and for generations to come. To deliver on this, we serve with passion, with a spirit of excellence, offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families. Our culture is based on our values rooted in respect: respect for ourselves, respect for others, respect for diversity and respect for the future.

We can trace our origin back to 1866, when the first European condensed milk factory was opened in Cham, Switzerland, by the Anglo-Swiss Condensed Milk Company. One year later, Henri Nestlé, a trained pharmacist, launched one of the world’s first prepared infant cereals ‘Farine lactée’ in Vevey, Switzerland.

Today, we employ around 273,000 people and have factories or operations in almost every country in the world. With our headquarters still based in the Swiss town of Vevey, we had sales of CHF 84.3 billion in 2020.

Our portfolio covers almost every food and beverage category – offering products and services for all stages of life, every moment of the day, helping people care for themselves and their families.

Job Number #174462 - Piscataway, New Jersey, United States

Who We Are

Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specializing in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!

Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.

Join a global supply chain powerhouse as our Distribution Strategy Lead ready to step directly into the center hub of our logistics operations. As our Distribution Strategy Lead, you will have a direct impact to drive the success of our logistics network by translating high level supply chain strategy into flawless, ground level execution in close collaboration with third parties. This role is for a resilient, proactive professional with end-to-end perspective who welcomes the complexity of the warehouse environment, possesses the fortitude to resolve operational bottlenecks, and thrives in pursuing excellence in efficiency and service delivery balance.

Your Day to Day, and The Future:

End to End Third Party Logistics Operations Orchestration

Take accountability for the end to end operational flow from inbound logistics to order fulfillment and on-time outbound loading across all assigned third party logistical operated networkOversee all warehouse related electronic data interchange transactions between WMS and SAP to deliver excellence in inventory management, systems integrity and superior quality controls Serve as the primary escalation point for major real time operational issues and bottlenecks, keeping the logistics operations flow steady and synchronized when challenges arise

Operational & Financial Governance

Design and enforce standard operating procedures, quality benchmarks, and robust onboarding metrics to ensure execution excellence and continuous improvementDeliver comprehensive governance over networking capital by minimizing the exposure to Slow Moving and Obsolete (SLOB) inventory through enhanced analytics and strong collaboration with cross-functional partners team protecting health of the P&LLead comprehensive, wall to wall physical inventory counts across all facilities, partnering directly with 3PLs and Corporate Finance and Audit, to safeguard stock valuation and minimize variance

Continuous Improvement & Strategic Projects

Partner directly with third party logistics providers to optimize workflows, eliminate waste, and exceed Right First Time operational goalsAnalyze complex performance data to remove unnecessary costs, boost throughput, and integrate innovative technology into the operationSpearhead cross-functional strategic initiatives, including complex WMS/SAP system implementations, facility upgrades, and process reengineering

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, or a related discipline6+ years of experience within Supply Chain, Warehousing, or Transportation LogisticsA proven track record of managing high volume third party logistics providers and driving measurable operational turnaroundsDemonstrated project management experience with the ability to orchestrate complex operations under tight timelines

Preferred Qualifications

High proficiency in SAP, Enterprise WMS, and advanced data visualization tools (Google Suite, Google Data Studio/Looker)Problem solving skills with a demonstrated ability to synthesize massive, complex datasets into actionable executive insightsRobust relationship management expertise, specifically regarding contract management, SLA enforcement, and strategic vendor negotiations

Compensation And Benefits

Salary Range $109,600.00 - $137,000.00 USD

Pay is determined based on experience, qualifications, and location. Salaried employees may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses, profit-sharing, and long-term incentives for Executive-level roles.

Benefits: Salaried employees enjoy a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, basic life insurance, paid parental leave, disability coverage, and participation in the 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions subject to eligibility requirements. Additional benefits include a minimum of 15 vacation/PTO days (hourly employees receive a minimum of 120 hours) and 13 paid holidays (vacation days are prorated based on the employee's hire date within the calendar year). Paid sick leave is adjusted based on role and location in accordance with local laws. Detailed information regarding paid sick leave entitlements will be provided to employees upon hiring and may be subject to adjustments based on changes in legislation or company policies.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

Job Location

SOUTHEAST FULFILLMENT CENTER

Job Description

Information Technology at Procter & Gamble is where business, innovation and technology integrate to build a competitive advantage for P&G. Our mission is clear -- we deliver IT to help P&G win with the over 5 billion consumers we serve worldwide. Our IT professionals are diverse business leaders who apply IT expertise to deliver innovative, tech-focused business models and capabilities for our 65 iconic, trusted brands.

From Day 1, you’ll be trusted to dive right in, take the lead, use your initiative, and build billion-dollar brands that help make everyday activities easier and make the world a better place! Our company offers purposeful work that will take your career places you never envisioned, in creative workspaces where innovation thrives and where your technical expertise is recognized and rewarded.

The Opportunity

P&G is hiring a Digital Security Leader to serve as the trusted cybersecurity authority at the site. The DSL will lead and represent all aspects of Information Security, Cybersecurity, and Application Governance.

In addition, they will work on the digital team to execute digital enhancements at the site. Their expertise will be essential in protecting our operations from potential information security incidents and ensuring that our facilities run smoothly and efficiently. Their role is to reduce risks and eliminate losses that could hinder a site’s ability to prevent, detect, and respond to information security incidents, ultimately ensuring the site’s ability to ship. This individual is responsible for the maintenance of the warehouse management system, and other compliance systems (including the WCSs). This individual will partner with the Site Leadership Team and Operations to continue to drive out technical losses and maintain compliance of systems.

Daily execution of cyber operations for the siteLeading digital projects with the site Digital LeaderOwns cybersecurity incident response for the site: First point of contact for site information security incident response, initiate the response process, and contribute to the Technical Information Security Leader and Business Information Security Leader's ownership of the response team.Owns compliance for all devices (EVP, whitelisting, operating systems management), technology, and application registrations Policy and Standards compliance & ongoing maintenance Owns value protections “digital safety” for the site and driving the cybersecurity culture and capability of the site. Executes IT and OT Asset Management Accountable for Governance Digital Systems Toolkit (IT Asset Management, Operating System Management) Actively participate in the available Cybersecurity Leader Community of Practices to bring back best practices, enhance site cybersecurity action plan and share for reapplication.Actively participate in the available Application Governance Community of Practices to bring back best practices, enhance site application action plan and share for reapplication.Proactively lead development, enrollment, and execution of the site cybersecurity action plan that feeds the site digital master plan.Serve as contributor to the site’s governance, risk, and compliance.

Job Qualifications

Required:

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information/Cyber Security, Information Technology, or related fields OR 4+ years of relevant cyber security experienceDemonstrated ability to lead key safety systems that others can follow and achieve the desired results. Willingness to learn and grow mastery in all digital systems/WMSsProficiency in Microsoft suite including data analytics tools (SQL & Power BI)Background or previous experience with both WMS & WCSsLeadership – demonstrated ability to be a ‘visible leader’ to enable an organization to continue creating a cyber security safety focus culture. Ability to lead, influence, and work effectively with all levels in the organization. Demonstrated ability to establish a vision and move a team to achieve.Communication – demonstrate ability to communicate the work to the organization’s leadership, as well as documenting processes.Database KnowledgeHas a can-do attitude, successfully manages multiple priorities, can operate under pressure, can internally assess risk, and knows when to ask for help.Ability to work onsite in Jackson, GA five days per week.

Preferred:

Prior warehousing/manufacturing work process experienceSuccessful completion of a formal Programming Language course (i.e., MSSQL, PHP, C, C++, Python)Successful Completion of one of the following: Windows Server formal Training, CCNA certification, or Linux Administration TrainingAbility to communicate complex technical problem statements concisely and effectively

Compensation for roles at P&G varies depending on a wide array of equal opportunity factors including but not limited to the specific office location, role, degree/credentials, relevant skills, and level of experience. At P&G compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. Total rewards at P&G include salary + bonus (if applicable) + benefits. Your recruiter may be able to share more about our total rewards offerings and the specific salary range for the relevant location(s) during the hiring process.

Job Location

Job Description



Information Technology at Procter & Gamble is where business, innovation and technology integrate to build a competitive advantage for P&G. Our mission is clear -- we deliver IT to help P&G win with the over 5 billion consumers we serve worldwide. Our IT professionals are diverse business leaders who apply IT expertise to deliver innovative, tech-focused business models and capabilities for our 65 iconic, trusted brands.



From Day 1, you’ll be trusted to dive right in, take the lead, use your initiative, and build billion-dollar brands that help make everyday activities easier and make the world a better place! Our company offers purposeful work that will take your career places you never envisioned, in creative workspaces where innovation thrives and where your technical expertise is recognized and rewarded.



The Opportunity



P&G is hiring a Digital Security Leader to serve as the trusted cybersecurity authority at the site. The DSL will lead and represent all aspects of Information Security, Cybersecurity, and Application Governance.



In addition, they will work on the digital team to execute digital enhancements at the site. Their expertise will be essential in protecting our operations from potential information security incidents and ensuring that our facilities run smoothly and efficiently. Their role is to reduce risks and eliminate losses that could hinder a site’s ability to prevent, detect, and respond to information security incidents, ultimately ensuring the site’s ability to ship. This individual is responsible for the maintenance of the warehouse management system, and other compliance systems (including the WCSs). This individual will partner with the Site Leadership Team and Operations to continue to drive out technical losses and maintain compliance of systems.



  • Daily execution of cyber operations for the site
  • Leading digital projects with the site Digital Leader
  • Owns cybersecurity incident response for the site: First point of contact for site information security incident response, initiate the response process, and contribute to the Technical Information Security Leader and Business Information Security Leader's ownership of the response team.
  • Owns compliance for all devices (EVP, whitelisting, operating systems management), technology, and application registrations
  • Policy and Standards compliance & ongoing maintenance
  • Owns value protections “digital safety” for the site and driving the cybersecurity culture and capability of the site.
  • Executes IT and OT Asset Management
  • Accountable for Governance Digital Systems Toolkit (IT Asset Management, Operating System Management)
  • Actively participate in the available Cybersecurity Leader Community of Practices to bring back best practices, enhance site cybersecurity action plan and share for reapplication.
  • Actively participate in the available Application Governance Community of Practices to bring back best practices, enhance site application action plan and share for reapplication.
  • Proactively lead development, enrollment, and execution of the site cybersecurity action plan that feeds the site digital master plan.
  • Serve as contributor to the site’s governance, risk, and compliance.



Job Qualifications



Required:



  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information/Cyber Security, Information Technology, or related fields OR 4+ years of relevant cyber security experience
  • Demonstrated ability to lead key safety systems that others can follow and achieve the desired results.
  • Willingness to learn and grow mastery in all digital systems/WMSs
  • Proficiency in Microsoft suite including data analytics tools (SQL & Power BI)
  • Background or previous experience with both WMS & WCSs
  • Leadership – demonstrated ability to be a ‘visible leader’ to enable an organization to continue creating a cyber security safety focus culture. Ability to lead, influence, and work effectively with all levels in the organization. Demonstrated ability to establish a vision and move a team to achieve.
  • Communication – demonstrate ability to communicate the work to the organization’s leadership, as well as documenting processes.
  • Database Knowledge
  • Has a can-do attitude, successfully manages multiple priorities, can operate under pressure, can internally assess risk, and knows when to ask for help.
  • Ability to work onsite in Jackson, GA five days per week.



Preferred:



  • Prior warehousing/manufacturing work process experience
  • Successful completion of a formal Programming Language course (i.e., MSSQL, PHP, C, C++, Python)
  • Successful Completion of one of the following: Windows Server formal Training, CCNA certification, or Linux Administration Training
  • Ability to communicate complex technical problem statements concisely and effectively
